sanskrit: dvividhaṃ trividhaṃ ca pare jaguḥtaccaturbhedaṃ yatoṣṭavidhamucyatekumudakaṃ śeṣamaṣṭadhāṃśaṃ vibhajya tuaṃśenātha tribhirbhāgairvājanaṃ parikalpayetāttādhiṣṭhānatuṅge tu caturviṃśatibhāgikepaṭṭikā kampaścaikaikāṃśād galaṃ dvayātviprabandhamidaṃ proktaṃ cārubandhaṃ tathocyatekampaścaikaikaṃ kaṇṭhoṃ'śāvabjamaṃśataḥcārubandhamadhiṣṭhānamidaṃ saṅkṛtibheditam [kam]ca vedāṃśaiḥ śeṣaṃ prāgiva puṣkalamvyāpikriyaṃ [g: yaṃ na pra] tat pratibandhakamsthāne vasvaṃśe bṛhadambujamūrdhvapadmamathaikāṃśādāliṅgāntaritaṃ tribhiḥśrībandhākhyamidaṃ proktaṃ devadvijanṛpocitamkumudaṃ prāgvat kampaṃ ca vājanamāliṅgāntaritaṃ dvyaṃśaṃ pratyunnatamathāṃśataḥdvicaturyavapādārdhatripādāṃśavivardhanātupānoparyupopānaṃ sapadmaṃ kampakaṃ tathāvedāśraḥ kumbhamaṇḍisamanvitaḥaṣṭāśro viṣṇukāntākhyaḥ skandakāntaḥ ṣaḍaśrakaḥṣāḍaśāśraścandrakānto vṛttaścedīśakāntakaḥkumbhamaṇḍyādisaṃyuktaṃ rudrakāntaṃ pracakṣatesabhadramadhyabhāgaśca bhadrakānto dvimaṇḍikaḥiṣṭākārastathaivordhvaṃ tattatkāntāhvayo bhavetsyānmūlacaturaśrākhyaḥ padmāpadmāsanaḥ smṛtaḥ

sanskrit: sa vijñeyo muktāstambhaḥ samauktikaḥmadhye ṣoḍaśāśrairalaṅkṛtaḥevāṣṭāśrako madhye śrīkhaṇḍaḥ paṭṭabandhavānpaṭṭakṣepaṇasaṃjñaḥ syāccaturaśrastripaṭṭadhṛkdaṇḍapādākhyo vajrapādaḥ kalāśrakaḥtribhāgaṃ ca bhittistambhavinirgamaḥmūlabhūstambhavistāro hyaṣṭāviṃśatikāṅgulaḥāttādhiṣṭhānatuṅgāt tu stambhotsedho dvidhā mataḥmūlāgrayorvyāsatuṅgatā stambhakuḍyayoḥkartavyā sthāpyāḥ [g: pāḥ] sarve tathāśmasu [kh: tma]pādoccanandabhāgād vā vasvaṃśād vedikocchrayaḥcitrakhaṇḍā śaivalā citraśaivalāvediḥ puṣpakhaṇḍeti kathyatecitrakhaṇḍābhidhīyateūrdhvādhaḥpadmapatrāḍhyā pāde pādāntare'pi casaivādharordhvāmbujayorvetrayugmamanoramā[rtha] vedikāṃ naivacchindyādanyatra toraṇātpuṣpakhaṇḍā citrakhaṇḍā nṛṇāṃ dve vedike smṛtetribhāge syād vedāśroṃ'śastu mūlataḥagrabhāgo'pi vedāśro bhavet stambheṣu keṣucitantyoṃ'śaḥ saptamāṃśono mūlavistārito bhavetsādhyardhāḥ pādahīnā vā dviguṇā vā bhavanti hikumbhāścaturdhā syurvṛttānāṃ [g: vā] śrīkaro bhavetstambhānāṃ caturaśrāṇāṃ saumukhyaḥ kumbha iṣyatekumbhabhāge navāṃśe tu dhṛgekena vidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śiṣṭabhāgadvayaṃ tryaṃśaṃ kṛtvaikenāmbujaṃ bhavetstambhāgrakarṇamārgeṇa skandhaḥ syāt samavistṛtaḥtriguṇitaṃ caturguṇamathāpi vāmaṇḍyutsedho bhavet tāvān vīrakāṇḍasya cocchrayaḥsārdhena phalakāsthaulyaṃ tatsamo vetranirgamaḥyajamānasukhāvahamprakāro'nyo dhṛkkaṇṭhāpādavistṛtiḥ [kh: ṇṭhaḥ]ambhojamālāsthānāni stambhāgre yojayet kramātsāṣṭāṃśādhikamardhaṃ vā tripādodayamambujambhavet pādāt triguṇo vā caturguṇaḥtribhiraṃśaistripādairvā vīrakāṇḍaśca tatsamaḥca tatsamaṃ jñeyaṃ maṇḍyutsedhopapādakampotikā sthāpyā tasyā lakṣaṇamucyatepañcaguṇaṃ vāpi nīcamadhyottamā smṛtānāmabhirjñeyāstāsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyatemadhyamā syādūnadvyaṃśā kaniṣṭhikāsā khyātā citrapotikāpotikā syāt taraṅgiṇīkāryāstūbhayatastulyāḥ paṭṭikācchannamadhyagāḥtadardhārdhena tadadhaḥ kṣemacchāyānvitaṃ bhavetsvavyāsārdhāt tripādād vā kuryāt tākhagramaṇḍanamgeheṣu narāṇāṃ śubhadāḥ smṛtāḥpatrabandhaṃ tato rūpottaraṃ bhavetsyādetasmāt pādonaṃ patrabandhakamnīcaṃ rūpottaramidaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadūrdhvāṃśadvayenāpi vedheyā padmapaṭṭikātu kapotaṃ syādupānasamanirgamamkampakaṃ kuryācchiṣṭenāpyūrdhvapaṭṭikātricatuṣpañcadaṇḍānāmāyāmastasya sammataḥvājanasyopariṣṭāt tu kuryād bhāratulāvalim [g: lī]tāsāmapyūrdhve kuryājjayantikāḥjayantyaścānumārgaḥ syād daṇḍārdhabahalaścitaḥtulādvārānugatāḥ syustato'pi caśilāmaye [g: yo] śilābhiḥ syādācchādyaṃ vājanoparivāpi nidrā vā daṇḍamucchritāvarṇapaṭṭī ca tulāpādaśca tadgataḥkapotaniryūhamutsedhaṃ bhinnaveṇuvatkapotālambanaṃ punaḥpotikādhastād gopānasyāstu lambanamtribhirvāṃśaistu bāhalyāṃ kampā yojyāḥ samantarāgopānanīprārdhād daṇḍikāniyamo bhavetcaturāyatasaṃsthānamanumārgeṇa bandhayetmuṣṭibandhaṃ tatpṛthag vājanoparipādāt pādavinirgatātattuṅgatricaturbhāganirgamātūrdhvādhastalayorbūmeravadhiḥ pratireva hidevānāmardhendurvaiśyaśūdrayoḥpratiḥ saśikharaṃ mukhapṛṣṭhaṃ pratidvayampratyuparyeva dvāraṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥstambhāyāme tu diṅnandavasusaptāṃśake kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadardhavistṛtaṃ ca syād dvāraṃ devālayeṣu vaivāṃśakaistribhiḥlabdhotsedhe tu diṅnandavasusaptāṃśake bhavetardhamaṇḍanakastambhau dvārasyobhayapārśvayoḥdvāravyāsoccamakhilamaṅgulicchedavarjitamrāmavṛddhāni manvāptāni vyayaḥ smṛtaḥtriṃśadāpte tu tithirvāraṃ ca saptabhiḥmārgarūpatarustambhakoṇaviddhamaśobhanamdvāroccaśeṣe paccāṃśe bhavedaṃśadvayaṃ tvadhaḥśreṣṭhamadhyādhamaṃ jñeyaṃ kramāt sarveṣu dhāmasutalpadaṇḍasya vistārastadardhaṃ taddhanaṃ bhavetbodhipatraṃ vāpyaśvaskandhanavākṛtiḥkavāṭaṃ caiva yogaścāpyekajātitarūdbhavauca syāt tasmānmiśraṃ na kārayetcaturdhā syuryugmaṃ cāyugmameva cakavāṭayugalābhyāṃ tu sthitābhyāṃ vāmadakṣiṇamsthitaṃ tvekamayugmākhyaṃ kapāṭakamkapāṭaṃ tad bhittigūḍhaṃ ca dhāvanamcānyeṣāṃ kavāṭāni bhavanti himanuṣyāṇāṃ syādayugmābhireva hisyāt kathyate skandhapaṭṭikānānārūpalatācitrā caturaśrā tu nirvraṇāskandhapaṭṭikā yugmapraveśe dakṣiṇāśritāśeṣamūrdhvaṃ kavāṭādermañjarībhiśca paṅkajaiḥsiṃhādibhirvyālairalaṅkuryād yathāruci
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhavecca talpavistārakarṇāyāmā tvayugmakeparighāpādayostuṅgaṃ taddairghyād dviguṇaṃ bhavetsthūlā tvekatalpasya [g: katve yasya] cārgalābadhnīyād yathaiva sudṛḍhaṃ bhavetvā vṛtto vā syād yathābalampañcānanopetaṃ kaṇṭhayugmaṃ yathārhataḥkavāṭe yojayet samausyād daṇḍairdaṇḍopadhānakaiḥkavāṭayogamadhyaṃ syāt tanmadhyaṃ bhittimadhyakamkramāccharāśvibhāge vā sthāpyo yogo'dhiko'ntareśeṣāṇāmupamadhye syād dvāroparyaṣṭamaṅgalamsārdhaṃ vā vistāro'pyanayormataḥtadūrdhvottaradaṇḍārdhasatripādasamodayampañcavaktrāṇi tāni syurdvidaṇḍoccāni madhyataḥdvitrivedāṅgulaṃ yuktyā patrāṇāṃ vitatiḥ smṛtādṛḍhapraveśāsyāt pārśvapatravicitritātānyeva devānāmapi varṇināmdvārālaṅkṛtiścābhyadhāyidevadvijanṛpāṇāṃ tu śastaṃ makaratoraṇampārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhataścāpi prakuryāt kuḍyatoraṇamvistārastadvyāse'tha śarāṃśakeśobhāntaraṃ tatra guhāveśo bhavedapinakrayorvadanāsaktamadhyapūrimamaṇḍitammakarasyottharatnamālādhiropitaiḥtūbhayato bhavenmakaratoraṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nyasyennārīnarādīṃśca yathāśobhaṃ vicitritamsyustatkuḍyaṃ pañcadhā smṛtamphalakāmayamapyantyaṃ mṛnmayaṃ cāparaṃ kramātnānājālakaniṣpādyaṃ kuḍyaṃ yajjālakāmayammadhye kuḍyaṃ syāt phalakāmayamcaturaśrāṃ vā kuḍyopari niyojayettanmadhye kāryā kuḍyalatā tridhāpadmāsanaṃ kuryāt tadūrdhvaṃ ca yathārucipatrairvinirgataiścitraṃ yathāśobhaṃ niyojayetkuryāt padmakumbhalatāyutamnakratoraṇavannyastā stambhakumbhalatā matāvijñeyā hi latā bhavetnandīśvaramahākālau pūrvadvārādhipau nyasetvāpyatha kaubere durgāṃ brahmāṇameva vātu kṣetreśaṃ caiśagocarevinyaseduktalakṣaṇamdakṣiṇāmūrtiṃ vīrabhadramathāpi vācaivaṃ tṛtīye tu marudgaṇāngandharvānapyapsarasaḥ siddhān nāgāṃstathā munīnkaṇṭhādadhaḥ praterūrdhvaṃ koṇe koṇe vṛṣān nyasetkaṇṭhādadhaścāntyatale prākārādau ca vinyasetgarbhārddhasamavistārā mahānāsāścaturdiśamkṣudranāsāstadardhād vā rāmāṃśād vāpi kārayetsiṃhapañjaramādau syāt pañjaraṃ cārdhapañjaramtathā khaṇḍaniryūhajhaṣapañjaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūcipādadvayopetaṃ śliṣṭaprākāranīprakamtathā sammukhapaṭṭikamprāsādanīprasaṃśliṣṭakhanīprādardhanirgatamsaśikharaṃ śaktidhvajasammukhapaṭṭikamca vistārapādasammitanirgamamsmṛtaṃ cātha svatulyaśikharāgrakamniryūhapañjaraṃ tvetallambanāsikamucyateyuktasarvāṅgaṃlambanāsikamnīprasaṃśritakarṇāṃśaṃ siṃhaśrotrābhidhānakamkapotādyaiḥ khaṇḍaniryūhakaṃ yutamkaṇṭhordhvatoraṇopetaṃ kapotādyaṅgasaṃyutamprāsādaṣaḍabhāgādaṃśaḥ śālā dvi gataḥpañjarotsedhastadvibhāgo'tra kathyateprastarotsedhastatsamaḥ karṇakochrayaḥtatstambhārdhādadhiṣṭhānaṃ śeṣeṇāpyupapīṭhakamtoraṇaśālāyā mūlādhiṣṭhānato'rdhataḥśālākūṭāntare śālāmadhye vā pañjaraṃ bhavetnāsīṃ tu na kurvīta kadācanasārdhaṃ vā dvitridaṇḍaṃ vā vedikoccaṃ prakalpayetprāgvadābhūṣya pādādau kuḍyabhūṣaṇamtricatuṣpañcadaṇḍaṃ vāpyuttarāntonnataṃ bhavetgavākṣaṃ ca gajākṣaṃ gulikā tathājālānāṃ saptabhedānāṃ pṛthag lakṣaṇamucyateāyāmacaturaśrordhvakarṇakaṃ syād gavākṣakammūlāgramadhyagulikamṛjubhittyantarārpaṇāt

sanskrit: vidigvakragattacchidraṃ gomūtrākhyaṃ tadākṛtipañcasūtrāntarā randhraiḥ prādakṣiṇyakṛtaṃ tu yatvedikādviguṇo'dhyardhaṃ samo vā syād galodayaḥgrīvāveśastadūrdhvaṃ syāccharāṃśāno'pi tatsamaḥvyālanāṭyakathābhirvā galabhūṣaṇamācaretdvidaṇḍamānena bhavecchikharanirgamaḥsakumbhāṃ kurvīta yathaiva śikharākṛtiḥcaturaśramāyatāśraṃ vṛttaṃ vṛttāyataṃ tathāityaṣṭau śikharākārāsteṣāmatha nigadyatedvayadhā bhaktamekadvitryaṃśako'pi caśikharoccānāṃ nāmānyapi ca saptadhāgāṅgeyaṃ śikharāṇi pṛthag viduḥstambhā vā hastavaṃśatulā apimanuṣyāṇāṃ praśastāḥ sarvadhāmasupādādhikaṃ vā syāt sārdhapādādhikaṃ tu vāagrasopānakaraṇaṃ guhyāguhyamiti dvidhāprakāraḥ syāt trikhaṇḍaṃ śaṅkhamaṇḍalamtrikhaṇḍākāranicitaṃ yat sopānaṃ trikhaṇḍakamtaddvikhaṇḍaṃ tu sopānamardhagomutrasaṃjñitamśayitavyāsapādārdhatripādoccāni vai pṛthakvādhyardhadaṇḍaṃ bhaveddhastabilaṃ tataḥśayitasyāpi praveśaḥ syād yathābalamdvitricaturdaṇḍo'śvapādakehastaghanaṃ vā syāt tripādaṃ vāsya coparisyāt prāsāde maṇḍape'pi vā

sanskrit: pārśvayormukhasopānamanyatra parimaṇḍayetupasañcitakaṃ ceti liṅgaṃ puṃstrīnapuṃsakamkapotādiśiroyuktaṃ puṁlliṅgaṃ nāma yad ghanamstrīliṅgaṃ vimānaṃ tadudāhṛtamṣaṇḍaṃ bhogābhogāṅgasaṃyutamkuryādadhaścordhve bāhye nālaṃ prayojayetnālasyāyāmaḥ pañcadhā smṛtaḥtāraṃ] ṣoḍaśamātrāntaṃ pañcadheti jagāda hatricatuṣpañcatanmātraṃ tāraṃ tatsamanimakamsiṃhavaktreṇa ghaṭitaṃ drāṅnatāgraṃ tu mūlataḥantaḥsthapīṭhanālasya samaṃ vā bāhyanālakammaṇḍapasyāpyadhiṣṭhānaṃ prāsādoktaṃ yadeva tatūrdhvadaṇḍāgravipulamārgaṃ ca kārayetsvastikākhyaḥ syād vīrāsanamināṅghribhiḥyutāḥ stambhairviśālāste'pi maṇḍapāḥcaturaśrāyataṃ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ daivamānuṣamyuktitaḥ kuryād bhāranāhottarocitamārāmapuṇyakṣetrādau grāmagehādimadhyataḥsārdhahastaṃ tu rasāṅgulavivardhanātekadvitricatuṣpañcabhāge bhaktyāntare [g: kṣyā] kṛtetritrimātravṛddhyā karāntataḥtatsarvaṃ tannāmnaiva prapadyateaṣṭahastāntamaṅghryaccaṃ trayoviṃśatpramāṇakamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ samārabhya cārdhārdhāṅgulavardhanātstambhotsedhe tu rudrāṃśe paṅktinandāṣṭabhāgike [ga]

sanskrit: mūrtimūrtīśaśaktīstu tribhāgeṣvapi vinyasetmūlāṅgamūrtimantraiśca juhuyuḥ śaktibhistataḥmantroddhāre pūrvameva mūlamantraḥ pradarśitaḥmahāsenaścaturthyanto vidmahetipadaṃ tataḥprakārānte codayāt tārapūrvikābhadrasenaḥ senānīśca bhavātmajaḥmayūravāhanaścaiva gāṅgeyaśca tataḥ paramsvākhyābhistanmantrāḥ syurnamontakāḥmāyūrakhādirāśvatthaplākṣaudumbararauhiṇāḥcaruṃ yavān vrīhīllāṁjasiddhārthasarṣapānśāntikumbhāmbhasā tathāmaṇḍapād dikṣu mantrairlokeśadaivataiḥcāpi vāyavyāṃ bilvakārṣmarisambhavāḥvāmataḥ pīṭhe kriyāśaktiṃ nidhāya tupraviśyātha lagne kūrmaśilāṃ nyasetvinyasya garteṣu madhye prāgādidikṣvapirasaṃ ca māṇikyaṃ madhyād bāhye kramānnyasetvastrādinācchādya bahirnirgatya deśikaḥpīṭhe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiraṃ yathātasyāmāvāhayed devaṃ mantrairebhiranukramātvibho iha vāraṇavāhana !svahṛdambhojāt paraṃ tejo guhātmakamniṣkalāntaṃ tu mūlaṃ haṃsaṃ ca kīrtayetsudhāmbhobhirāplāvyātha sacetanāmmūlāṅgāni ca gāyatrī mūrtimantrāśca sa smṛtaḥ

sanskrit: tathā mūrdhni nābhau guhye ca pādayoḥmūrtīśanidrākumbhāstraiḥ snapayitva tu pūjayetkṣiptvā praviśyāntardehalyāṃ tannidhāya cakṛtvārghyaṃ śuddhīḥ pañca vidhāya tuādhāraśaktyanantākhyamayūrāsanagātragānvidyāyāḥ śaktīrmadhye ca pūjayetvyāpinī ceti pūrvādikramāllalitavigrahāḥyajed divyāmbarādikaiḥmūrtyaṅgaiḥ śaktibhiḥ sakalīkṛtamsvāṅgaiḥ patrāgre [kh: grairmū] mūrtimūrtipaiḥdvāḥsthaiścaturthaṃ lokeśaiḥ pañcamaṃ tu tadāyudhaiḥsthirādibhiḥ saptamantrairhutvā spṛśed guhamcaturthadivase'bhyarcya dhūrtasenaṃ tu beragamraktavarṇaṃ nirmālyairabhipūjayetskandagāyatryā tilājye juhuyāt pṛthaksviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvāgnīn hṛdi saṃharetsnapayenmantraiḥ śaivoditaiḥ kramātpradeyāni dattvā śaktyā tu pūrvavatpūrvoktaṃ puṣkalaṃ labhate phalamvighnaviśveśvarau cātha vīrasenasuṣeṇakauskandapāriṣadāntāḥ syurlokeśāḥ svasvadiggatāḥdhūrtasenaṃ tathaiśānyāṃ saṃpūjyaiṣāṃ baliṃ harettu balipīṭhāgrataḥ sthitaḥsarve gṛhṇantu balimuttamambāhyahārāyāmunmāthādīn gaṇeśvarān

sanskrit: unmāthaśca pramāthaśca subhāso bhāsvaro maṇiḥdaśamūrtibhyo balipīṭhe baliṃ kṣipetvardhanaśca kumudo nandanastathāvidhiścaiṣa tulyaśca syānmahotsavetataḥ skandagaṇān sarvān prāgvadāvāhayet guruḥkoṭikoṭigaṇeśāḥ syurdvātriṃśat syurgaṇeśvarāḥsumukhaḥ suvrato vahnidiggatāḥnair-ṛte kālo balaścātibalo'lasaḥvāyavye meghamālī sthirastathāmeghanādaśca saṃgrahonmāthavigrahāḥcatvāraḥ koṭikoṭigaṇeśvarāḥskandapāriṣadānte tu svāhāntaṃ tu baliṃ kṣipetkurvīta yathāpūrvaṃ nimantrya tupratisarārambhaṃ tvamanujñātumarhasīsvakairmantraiḥ kṛtvā pratinivṛtya tudattvā mukhyādisnapanena tuvidhivanmahāpūjāṃ pravartayetsyāt tāraśaktiravādikaḥdaivaṃ tu devo harehariḥ svayamṣaṭ tena śastrāntāni tu kalpayethṛdādīni sve sve sthāne kramānnyasettasyānte dhīmahe tacca naḥpadamgāyatrī yajanocitācānte namaḥ syād yajane manuḥsthāne harārdhe ca vāsudevaṃ tathānyataḥ

sanskrit: mūrdhāsyahṛtsuguhyāṅghryorharerardhaṃ nyaset kramātkathyate tatrāpyadhivāsanamaṇḍapamśāntibhūtibalārogyāstoraṇe dakṣiṇārdhagāḥvāmārdhe pūjanīyāḥ svanāmabhiḥnandīśapūrṇau ca mahākālaśca puṣkaraḥvīrasenaḥ ṣaṇmukhaśca suṣeṇakaḥvikirakṣepapūrvaṃ tu kumbhe harahariṃ yajetmadhyakuṇḍānalaṃ prāgvannavadhā saṃvibhajya tumantrasantarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryāccākāraśodhanamyathā pūrvaṃ maṇḍape śayanaṃ tathāsānantāṃ pṛthivīṃ sūkṣmayuktāmbhaśca śivottamamkumbhāṃstu nyaset tattvādikaṃ tataḥtattveśān mūrtīḥ pṛthvyādikā ravimbhāgeṣu mūrtidvādaśakaṃ nyasetśivāṃ sūkṣmāṃ śāṅkarīṃ harivallabhāmsāmānyaśaktayo hyetā haranarāyaṇasya yāḥjñānā kriyā yogā tathaiva casaṃpūjya dhyātvā tu sakalaṃ vibhumdhārikādyāśca śaktīraṣṭau yajedapigāyatryā śaivoktena krameṇa tumūrtipāścaiva saṃspṛśeyuḥ kramāt tridhātulyamūhyaṃ syādaśeṣeṇa tu deśikaiḥdhāriṇīṃ śaktiṃ tattvatattveśvarādibhiḥpīṭhaṃ tatsthāṃ ca kriyāśaktiṃ ca śaktibhiḥmūlenāvāhya tanmūrtiṃ mantradehaṃ ca bhāvayet

sanskrit: cāpi mūlāṅgādyairyathākramampālāśasamidājyairyathākramamprāyaścittaistathā hutvā pūrṇāṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ tathātoraṇadhvajalokeśadvārakumbhasthadevatāḥsaviśeṣaṃ tu dakṣiṇādyaṃ pradāya tubhaktyā yatheṣṭaṃ labhate phalampracaṇḍaśca bhṛṅgī vighnaśca dakṣiṇelokapālebhyaḥ svaiḥ svairmantrairbaliṃ kṣipetgaṇeśaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca mātṝḥ śāstārameva casaśūlacakravaradābhītimiṣṭvā baliṃ kṣipetgopuradvāri saṃpūjyaiṣāṃ baliṃ kṣipetāyāntu pārṣadāḥ sarve śāṅkarā vaiṣṇavāśca yenandīśādibhyaḥ kumudādibhya eva canandīśaśca mahākālo bhūtanātho mahīdharaḥpuṇḍarīko'tha vāmanaḥtatastu balipīṭhe tu bhūtidādibhya eva camusaline pāśine'ṅkuśine tathāpīṭhābjakarṇikāyāṃ baliṃ kṣipetnityotsavavidhistveṣa tulyaścāpi mahotsavesvanāmnaiva baliṃ ca vikiret tataḥmahākālo vidhātā ca vajrapāṇiḥ kratu(ḥ?) prabhuḥvidyutprabhaścaiva śūlahastastrilocanaḥmahāvīryo nityayogaḥ prasādanaḥaśvagrīvo'śvavadano hyaśvajihvo'śvalocanaḥkandaḥ kandukalocanaḥ

sanskrit: pāṇḍupṛṣṭhaśca durdinaḥ sudinastathābhāvano bhagavān bhavaḥviśvasenaśca viṣvakseno visāraṇaḥkāmuko'kāmukaścaiva kāmahṛt kāmanāśanaḥagniragnisamānaśca jvālāmālī ca viśvabhukraktavapūrdhūmraḥ saptārcirviśvabheṣajaḥyogapriyo dārujaścāpyāgneyo nidhanastathāmaṇḍūrmaṇḍūkakākāsyau devo devalakastathādroṇamārīco mahiṣo bhīṣaṇastathācaiva matsarī maskarastathāsiṃhamukhaścaiva nārasiṃho narastathānālakarṇaścetyāgneyyāṃ diśi saptatiḥpretādhipo dharmaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇākṣa eva cakṛtāntaśca satyaḥ satyapriyaḥ suhṛtdharmajaścāpi dhanvī ca praśrayo nayaḥniranukrośaḥ kubjaḥ pāṃsuvimardanaḥsaṃrakṣaṇastathāsubhadraśca śārṅgī śārṅgadharastathāvallakīhasto dvirado vigraho'mbaraḥrākṣasaścāsuraḥ kravyād vīrahā nir-ṛtistathākaikaseyaḥ krūraḥ krūravapustathāvīrūpākṣo'tha bhasmāṅgaḥ sukṛtirvikṛtistathāmāṃsakaściva rākṣaso rakṣakastathāvīraseno'kṣarāśaśca prāṇadaḥ praṇavastathāviśālākṣo raktajihvo vijihmakaḥ

sanskrit: dhātā kapilaḥ piṅgalocanaḥnīlagrīvaḥ kapardī ca vṛṣavāho vṛṣadhvajaḥvaśī śambhurvivāsā vyasano budhaḥbrahmavid brahmo mārīco haripiṅgalaḥsudṛṣṭiraṣṭātmā śaṅkaraḥ śāṅkarastathāsarvabhuk sarvo vinodī dīpakampakaḥśikhaṇḍī cetyaiśānyāṃ saptatirgaṇāḥpraveśyāntaḥ snātvā prāgvad yajedapiprāgvad gaṇān sarvān visṛjya cadeśikādibhyo dakṣiṇāstadanantaramśaivoditakriyācakraṃ prāyastulyamihāpi hipañcamasya tṛtīyakamlipisadīrghaṃ [k: repi] ca dvādaśasvaravān marutsvarairyuto nādaḥ sāgniryukto hṛdādibhiḥpūjāyāṃ śaktitāradvayādikākanyākumāryaiśabdānte dhīmahīti padaṃ bhavetdurgāgāyatrī pūjayedanayā śivāmtāmagnivarṇāmagnetvaṃviśvānītyādikā tataḥmantrādhvā durgāyāstantracoditaḥsvāsīnā sthitā vā mahiṣoparivaradābhayaśaṅkhārihastā durgā caturbhujāśūleṣukhaḍgacakrāṇi dakṣiṇe'ṣṭabhujā yadātathā vāme bibhratīmatha dakṣiṇecādhaḥkarādyaṃ tu kuryād dvyaṣṭabhujā yadākāryāḥ prāgvat kṣīratarūdbhavāḥ

sanskrit: śarabhāge tu dvibhāgoccaṃ tu vā talam [lakam]sopapīṭhamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kevalaṃ vā masūrakamkapotapratisaṃyuktaḥ sāmānyo maṇḍapaḥ smṛtaḥprapāthavāvā caturdvāraṃ caturbhistoraṇānvitamvadantīha maṇḍapaṃ vā prapāmapipuroktaḥ syād vedartvaṣṭadaśāṅgulaiḥtvaksārairnirmitā vā syurūrdhvavaṃśottarāṇyapianyairvāpyupapattyā tu patraiḥ pracchādayet prapāmvedikoccaṃ syānmadhye raṅgaṃ ca kalpayetdvyaṃśastalimāyāmaḥ prastaroṃ'śena tasya tuvasustambhaṃ ṣoḍaśastambhakaṃ tu vāśālāsabhāprapāṇāṃ vā maṇḍapānāṃ tu madhyataḥmṛt sudhā ceti ṣaḍvidhāni pracakṣatepañcānāṃ saṅgrahaḥ pūrvamucyatelatāśliṣṭāḥ kīṭajuṣṭāḥ sakaṇṭakāḥbahupakṣimṛgairjuṣṭāścaityamārgaśmaśānajāḥpalāśāḥ kuṭajā lodhrā bilvapīluśirīṣakāḥpathyākṣāmalakāḥ pārthāḥ snuhisnugvaraṇā apinyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣaśalmalitindukāḥsarpamārārimedāśca putrajīvāḥ saḍuṇḍukāḥvarjanīyāḥ syurdevamānuṣadhāmasuvarṣavātātapasahā jalasthalasahāśca yekṣīrataravo na manuṣyagṛhocitāḥvṛttākārastu mūlāgrād bahuśākho dṛḍhāyataḥ

sanskrit: satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahaumanovākkarmabhihiṃsāstrividhāḥ prāṇināmihasatyaṃ yadā]bhūtānāṃ hitaṃ cet satyameva tatparigṛhītānāṃ tyaktānāṃ vāśramādiṣuparārthānāmanādānamasteyaṃ paramaṃ smṛtamtatrāpyupasthaviṣayanivṛttiṃ tu viśeṣataḥyoṣitsaṃbhogavaimukhyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ viduḥṛtusnātābhigamanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ smṛtamasvīkaraṇamarthānāṃ mukhyaḥ syādaparigrahaḥgṛhastho vā vānaprastho'thavā muniḥasatpratigrahebhyastu nivṛttiraparigrahaḥtadvadīśvarapūjeti pañca bhinnāstu te punaḥacintanamakṛtyānāṃ yat tacchauca tu mānasammalānāṃ kṣālanañcāntaḥkaraṇasya viśodhanamvarṇāśramādidharmāṇāmavirodhāgatena tu(ga)teṣvananuśokaḥ syād bhaviṣyārtheṣvalolatāharṣāgameṣvanutsekaḥ śokasthāneṣvaśokatātathābhyāsastathopaniṣadāmapinirdiṣṭastrividho'pi ca yogināmśarīrasya yattattapa udāhṛtamvratacoditakālāśī tapasvī yogabhāg bhavetcoditārādhanaṃ śambhoryat tadīśvarapūjanamyajanaṃ karmaṇā manasāpi cavasiṣṭhaśca yogācāryau mahāmunī

sanskrit: satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dayārjavamāstikyaṃ dānamīśvarapūjanamāsanānyapi coktāni bahudhā pūrvapaddhataupadmasaṃjñaṃ ca bhadraṃ yogāsanaṃ tathāniviṣṭamtadāhuḥprāṇasya dhāraṇaṃ dehe prāṇāyāma itīritaḥkumbhakaścaiva recakaśceti te trayaḥtribhiraṅgairyutastryaṃga syākutpūrakaṃ vinā (?)nirdiṣṭodghātamātrābhirvijñeyaḥ sa tu pūrakaḥtiṣṭhed yadāsau kumbhakaḥ smṛtaḥkrameṇa yo mokṣo recakaḥ paripaṭhyateṣaṣṭimātraḥ syāt pañcoddhātastu saṃsmṛtaḥhyayaṃ mando madhyo'smād dviguṇo bhavetsagarbhāśca prāṇāyāmāstu te smṛtāḥantarjapavihīnā ye te tvagarbhā iti smṛtāḥkumbhīkṛtyodare vāyuṃ svasvamantraṃ dhiyā japetsvamantraścet tasya syād dviśataṃ japaḥhāpayi]tvāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaretvidhātavyāstattaddhyānopabṛṃhitāḥśarīrādadhikaṃ prāṇaḥ syād dvādaśāṅgulamsa ca tryaśro devādīnā nṛṇāmapicatuṣpadānāṃ hṛnmadhye kroḍamadhye'ṇḍajanmanāmnābhicakraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tu dvādaśāramasusthitiḥprasuptabhujagākārā caturaṅgulavistṛtā

sanskrit: aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāḥ syustāsāṃ mukhyāstu nāḍayaḥpiṅgā suṣumnā ca gāndhārī hastijihvikāpiṅgalā ca suṣumnā cottamāḥ smṛtāḥvimalā ghoṣaṇī pṛthvī tatastvāpyāyanī matāmṛdvaṅgī snaṃsanī? cāpi marśanīhṛtpadmagata āsanāddhṛdayasthitiḥkurute nityaṃ ya(syā? smāt) prāṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| hānopādānakarmā ca tasmād vyāna iti smṛtaḥgātranetravikārādyaṃ karmodānasya tu smṛtamtvagasṛṅmāṃsamedosthisaṃsthā nāgādivāyavaḥnīlendragopagokṣīravidyudarkendusaprabhāḥnāgasya kūrmasyonmīlanādikamśo(bhā? ṣādyaṃ) mṛtaṃ ca na vimuñcatibindormūrdhānamāsādya brahmarandhreṇa nirgatāsthite vāmadakṣiṇaprāṇayoḥ sṛte [kh: smṛ]vāmāṅghreraṅguṣṭhāgrād vinirgatātvadho nābheḥ pāyumūlāntanirgamā| nāḍayo vimalādyāstu daśa hastāgranirgatāḥviśvodarodaraṃ yātā sarasvatyapi meḍhragātāḥ sarvāḥ padmatantuvi * * *bahirnirgatāgrā romasaṃjñāḥ śarīragāḥkoṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca keśaromāṇi dehagāḥtu tato'rdhārdhaṃ sirāromāṇi saṃkhyayāsarve te prāṇinaḥ [nā] smṛtāḥsevyāni tāni viditāni yathopadeśam

sanskrit: anyonyasandhividdhaṃ tu śikhākīlaṃ na vedhayetdakṣiṇottarayoryuktā śikhā sampatkarīi bhavetkīlakasyāpi vistāro bhāgato bhavetmiśrasandhirvināśāya tasmānmiśraṃ tu varjayetantarantaniyojyaṃ syād dakṣiṇādakṣiṇā tathāsandadhyācchayitadravye samaṃ vāpi trayaṃ kvacitbahiścātra śayitadravyasandhiṣutridravyairbrahmarājākhyo veṇuparvābdhibāṇakaiḥbahusandhirbahudravyairdaṇḍikāsandhirucyatesarvatobhadraṃ tattadākārasandhayaḥvināśāya yatastanna samācaretprakurvīta saukhyāyussaṃpravṛddhayeyathāvatsthapatireṣṭavyaḥ śilpaśāstraviśāradaḥvṛtaḥ kartā vastukarma samācaretniṣpādyamāsamāpteḥ syāt tābhyāmeva hi netaraiḥāsamāptervidheyaṃ hi citrasthaguruśāsanātprāgvadadhivāsya vidhānataḥsarvaratnauṣadhībījalohadhāturasānapipradakṣiṇakrameṇaiva madhyaśvabhre nidhāya tukoṇeṣu catasro'pīṣṭakā nyasetsūcikāgraṃ vā śikharākārameva vāānupūrvyāt kṛśaṃ kuryādagre cāṅgulivistṛtamśikhipādavatmadhyame garte stūpyāyāme śarāṃśake

sanskrit: śuśrūṣārthapradānādyairārādhya paritoṣya caguruṇā gatvā deśaṃ manoramamvātha prājya[k: ṇya]mūlaphalodakeyogī nissaṃgo vijitendriyaḥyuktasvapnāvabodhanaḥpicutūlādisaṃpūrṇa āsane sottaracchadecātha namaskṛtya tataḥ śivaumatimān na drutaṃ na vilambitamhṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhrasthitāḥ kramātvāmanāsāpuṭenātha pūrayenmarutodaramnirundhyānnirgamaṃ tasya kumbhakākhyaḥ sa tu smṛtaḥvāmaghrāṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇenaiva recayetdvyaṣṭamātrābhirnābhipadme caturmukhamcatuṣṣaṣṭimātrāmātraṃ tu dhārayetśaṅkhacakradharaṃ saumyaṃ samādhisthaṃ caturbhujammakāramūrtiṃ tu bhrūmadhyakamale smaraneṇaṭaṅkadharaṃ saumyamindumauliṃ kapardinamvāyuṃ samāpūrya bhruvo'ntarātjapenmātratrayādhikambhūtaśuddhyuktamārgeṇa prāṇāyāmāstu pañca tesandhyayorvāyumākṛṣya piban vāggmī ca jāyatemūrdhnyathātmānamādhāyāpūrya mārutamvisṛjed vāyuṃ bādhiryādeṣa mucyaterujā dehe tatra tatra tu mārutamsamutkṛṣya vahnisthāne niyojayet

sanskrit: nābherāmūrdhato vīṇādhvanirnādaḥ pravartatetasyātha prāṇo'pyuccaratīcchayājanayecchaśvadahorātre tu saṃkhyayāghaṭikānāṃ smṛtaḥ ṣaṣṭyā tvahorātrastu mānuṣaḥnābhipadme dhyātvā tu caturānanamdhiyaiva praṇavaṃ japanhṛdayābjasthaṃ vāsudevaṃ caturbhujamcaturbāhumudārasthamukāramayavigrahamvidhāya syāt prāṇāyāmastu vaiṣṇavaḥrudraṃ dhyāyaṃstrilocanampūrakādyairyathāpūrvaṃ raudro'yaṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥproktarūpādiṃ dhyāyaṃstāraṃ japan dhiyāmūrdhni kamale dhyāyan devaṃ sadāśivamsarvadoṣaharo'yaṃ syāt sādeśaḥ prāṇasaṃyamaḥsarvakalmaṣadoṣaghnāḥ sarve sarvārthasādhakāḥhṛtpadmamadhye vā vi(ndū? ndau) vā vyomapaṅkajepuryaṣṭakāṣṭacchadane svasvāṅgāvaraṇānvitejapan buddhyā pūrakādikrameṇa tuhṛdayābjādau paśyañ jyotirnirañjanamdhyāyaṃstrimātraṃ cinmātrapraṇavaṃ vā dhiyā japankuṇḍalinyāstu dhyāyañcchaktiṃ vinirgatāmparamāmṛtaniḥṣyandaiḥ plāvyamānāṃ tato'pi hisuṣumnayordhvaṃ gacchantīmamṛtāsāravarṣiṇīmjapan dhiyā yathāpūrvaṃ prāṇānāyamya yogavitpraṇavādyāṃ tu saptavyāhṛtipūrvikām

sanskrit: paramātmānaṃ sāvitrīṃ sūryameva vākurvan yogī siddhimavāpnuyātmanovākkarmajānīha pātakāni vināśayetaṣṭottarasatasyāpi (?) bhrūṇahatyāṃ ca nāśayetbalādāharaṇaṃ teṣāṃ pratyāhāraṃ pracakṣatehṛdyanuṣṭhānaṃ pratyāhāraṃ vidurbudhāḥsthāpanaṃ kecit pratyāhāraṃ vadanti hikaṭistataḥ kando nābhī hṛdayavakṣasīcāṣṭādaśaiteṣu sthānāt sthānaṃ krameṇa turogaśāntiḥ syādāyuṣo vardhanaṃ tathāātmanyavasthitiṃ buddherdhāraṇaṃ sampracakṣatekāraṇeśvarāntu tatraiva pratītyantaravarjitāmpraṇavākṣarasambhedāt kṣityādyairmaṇḍalākṣaraiḥsvamātmānaṃ sarvagaṃ? sarvavedināsakalaṃ dhyānaṃ nirākāraṃ tu niṣkalambhedairiṣṭasurākārasmaraṇaṃ hṛdayādiṣubhruvormadhye bindau vā dvādaśāntagekadambagolakākāraṃ bhābhāsitadigantaramdvādaśāntasthaśivenāpyekatāṃ gatamvyāptaṃ dhyāyenniścalamānasaḥta]tayuktātmā yogī nirdhūtabandhanaḥṣaḍūrmibhirasaṃspṛṣṭo maitrādiguṇavarjitaḥpāśān paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchatidvādaśakāyāmaḥ samādhirbhavati sphuṭam

sanskrit: janmādistūpyantaṃ vasanairnavaiḥcaturvarṇaudanaiścāpi yā (vī? vaiḥ) kṛsarapāyasaiḥsamāpūrya vāstubhūtabaliṃ niśikriyāḥ kṛtvā vimānamadhiruhya tuvimānaṃ tad gandhādyairarcayet tataḥlikhitvā tu netramokṣaṃ tathācaretviprāṃśca dhānyarāśiṃ ca kāñcanamdhvajaṃ prāgvat stūpyagragranthitānanamvedisthakalaśakuśāmbhobhiśca sarvataḥvimānādavaruhyātha sthapatistakṣakairvṛtaḥsaṃprokṣya cāṣṭa dhānyāni vikiret sarvato'picapūrṇāñjalirimāñślokān paṭhed devānanusmaranpṛthivīmavatātśrīsaubhāgyārogyabhogān kṛṣīransthāpako'pi svakarmātha samāpayetcāśeṣaṃ prāsādaṃ prokṣayet kramātprāsādabījaṃ haṃsāḍhyaṃ dvādaśāntād viniḥsṛtamtataścārghyādibhistadvad gandhādyaiśca yathākramamyajamānastataḥ svarṇavasanābharaṇādibhiḥvimānakaraṇodīrṇaparikleśaphalātmakamtu sthapatirdadyāt saliladhārayāna gṛhṇīyāt pramugdhadhīḥathānyānapi takṣādīn kartā karmakarānapigodhānyadhvajavastrādyaṃ dadyāt sthapataye'khilamsthapatiḥ sākṣād yajamānaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ

sanskrit: sthirameva syād dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradamcaturdvārādisaṃyuktaṃ prāgvadābhūṣya maṇḍapamtarpaṇāntaṃ tu karma dīkṣāvadācarettu saṃsnāpyācchādya vāsasāśāyayed vedyāṃ puruṣaṃ pralayākalamtārahṛtsampuṭaṃ haṃsamuddhṛtyātmapadaṃ tataḥuccāryāthāñjaliṃ puṣpairāpūrya dvādaśāntataḥhṛtpadme nāḍīmārgeṇa yojayetanenaiva prakāreṇa vidyārāgādikānyapiviśeṣeṇa kāryaṃ bhinnaṃ praśasyatecandro diśaśca vāyuśca sūryo'tha varuṇo'śvinauviṣṇurmitro brahmā ca te kramātśco)ditaṃ karma syāt saṅkalpavikalpakamuktyupādānagamanavisargānandakarmaṇāmtārahṛdbījapūrvaṃ śabdādipañcakampañcātha namontaṃ pūrvavad vadetpūrvavad vācyā namontaṃ sacaturthikamtārahṛtpūrvakaṃ tadvannamontaṃ sacaturthikamsuyaśālambuṣe pūṣāṃ kuhūmapyatha śaṅkhinīmkṛkaraṃ devadattaṃ dhanañjayamsvādhikārapūrvakatvena saṃsmaranaṅguṣṭhamātraprabhṛtimantraiḥ prerakatāṃ tathānirodhayenniṣṭhurayā trikhaṇḍādhvānamapyathakuṇḍāntikaṃ gatvā śaktimādhārasaṃjñitāmvinyasya tathājyāhutibhiḥ punaḥ

sanskrit: vidyādyādhāraśaktyantaṃ pṛthagitthaṃ nirodhayetkḷptaśayyāyāṃ hemādyekatamaṃ ghaṭamsūkṣmavāsoyugacchannamiṣṭvā gandhādibhiḥ kramātprāyaścittamaghoreṇa hutāthācāryadakṣiṇāmca vahniṃ ca yathāpūrvaṃ visarjayetprāsādaḥ syāt supratiṣṭho maheśaḥskhalitaṃ jīrṇaṃ prāsādāṅaṃ yadā bhavetprāgvadeva syādalaṅkārādikaṃ ca yatjāticchandavikalpānāṃ syānmānaṃ prāgvadeva hipatitaṃ tasya na vṛddhirdoṣamāvahettatproktasthāne kuryāt salakṣaṇampūrvasaṃsthānasundaramcālayelliṅgaṃ pūrvasthāne'rhati sthitimsahasradaṇḍāntakṣeme saṃsthāpayet punaḥprāyaścittādanantarammūlālayād rakṣoyamāgnimarutāṃ diśaḥbharturnṛpasyāpanmarudrakṣogniṣu kṣayaḥproktanād dhiṣṇyāt prāgvodakparito'dhikampūrvasmāddhīnamānādyaṃ sthānaṃ kartṛnṛpāhitamvinaṣṭavastuno garbhaṃ tyaktvā garbhaṃ nyaset punaḥprāktanadravyairniṣpādyaṃ ced gṛhādikamyogairnavairnaveṣviṣṭaḥ purāṇānāṃ purātanaiḥpuragrāmālayādīni pūrvavastvanukūlataḥbahirmūlādalpaliṅgālayādikammūlālayasamaṃ kṣudramadhikaṃ ca na śaśyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kramādindrādivāyvantaṃ mūlāt tu śivamandiramdhanaṃ ca sasyaṃ ca tasmāt tat parivarjayetmukhyādiparjanyāntaṃ ca pūrvataḥprākpaścimāsyastu manuṣyāṇāṃ hitāvahaḥsaumyā devatāḥ śubhadā nṛṇāmmanuṣyālayaṃ kuryād devāgārādhikonnatamśubhaṃ nyūnaṃ samaṃ vā mānuṣa gṛhamvairūpyaṃ hīnādhikyaṃ ca ninditamdeśadeśādhipasthānakartṛbhartṛvināśanamstrīvināśāya stambhe nṛpaparājayaḥnāsikāsu svapakṣaghnaṃ śikhare rājavibhramaḥasthānadvārasopānaṃ sarveṣāmaśubhāvahamacoditālaṅkaraṇamanyaccāniṣṭaduḥkhadamtasmād dhāma kuryāt salakṣaṇamsukhaṃ ca nairdhanyaṃ kuryāt pūrvādidigdarīca puṣṭiṃ ca vināśaṃ cāvahet kramātkṣaudrasya nyāsaḥ sarvatragarhitaḥkanyāgamaṃ putraṃ kalahaṃ raktakanyakāuktādavāntare'nyatra dvāre ca kalahādikamvanakapotakāḥdevamānuṣageheṣu maṭhagoṣṭhasabhādiṣukhananādikriyābhistadapanīyopalipya tuvāstuhomaṃ ca dattvā vāstubaliṃ tataḥyathāvadāvaset tasmin sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ bhavetkramaśaḥ kuryāt pañcatridvyekasaṃkhyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maryādā mahāmaryādakaṃ tataḥśararṣibṛhatīrudrahastaṃ yathākramātmūlārdhaṃ prathamaṃ tvatha carṣibhiḥsyād viṣkambhaḥ sārdhahastavāntattadviṣkambhamānāt tu triguṇaṃ vā caturguṇamkṣudrālpabhittiviṣkambhaṃ hastādārabhya pūrvavatsottarāvājanacchatraśīrṣavatyaśca bhittayaḥ[k, kh: rāṃ] kuryāt parito vṛṣabhāvalimhīnaṣaṇmātraṃ pratisālaṃ ca tatkramātmahāmaryādabhittyantamevaṃ hāpyamathāpi vātaccaturmātrairyāvat pañcāntasālakamtu yamopānte gajavaktrasya nair-ṛtevāyavyāmathavaiśānyāmumādurgālayaḥ smṛtaḥdhātuḥ syānnṛttasyaiśe'thavā puraḥsnapanāmbugṛhaṃ smṛtamrakṣombumadhye śastrāṇāṃ gośālā varuṇe bahiḥvidyāpīṭhaṃ bhavenmukhye parjanye kṣetrapasya tulokeśānāṃ svadikṣveva cendrāgnyormadhyato'śvinoḥśāstuśca rakṣodigbhāge bhadrakālyāstathā bahiḥvastūnāmambumarutormunināṃ vāyusomayoḥparivāravimānānāṃ mānaṃ garbhārdhamānataḥvapraṃ syāt parivārāṣṭakaṃ tathācaṇḍeśvaraścāṣṭau parivārāḥ prakīrtitāḥmadhyame dhāmni dvādaśaite bhavanti hiparivārāḥ syurmadhyame dhāmni ṣoḍaśa

sanskrit: vāstudevāṃśca kramādīśānapūrvakānśayane'pi syuriti prāha pitāmahaḥlokeśān yajedeva pradakṣiṇamdevaṃ pranālamapi cottaretripādaṃ vā prāsādārdhamathāpi vātridvyekahastamuccaṃ taduttamādiṣu kalpayetkumudaṃ bhāgaḥ paṭṭikāṃśaistribhirgalaḥbhāgenetyatha tadvyāse daśāṃśe dvyaṃśahānitaḥvābjodayaḥ proktaḥ karṇikā tattribhāgataḥalaṅkārairvimānoktairyuktaṃ vā baliviṣṭarambahiḥ prācyāṃ dhvajastambhaṃ tu vinyasetdvāraliṅgasamaḥ śreṣṭho madhyo vedāṃśahīnataḥdvārādadhyardhamucco vā sapādadviguṇocchritaḥlakṣma yathāvadatha kathyatedvārāṇāṃ tatra vistārādutsedhaḥ pañcadhocyatedviguṇo'rdhādhikaḥ pādamadhikaḥ pañcadhocchrayaḥsaṃtyajya dakṣiṇādakṣiṇakramātpādādhiṣṭhānatuṅgaṃtvaṃ vedeṣvṛṣibhujaṅgamaiḥsādhiṣṭhānāṅghrituṅgaḥ syāccheṣaṃ syādupapīṭhakampaṭṭikāṅgamadhiṣṭhānastambhamānaṃ tu mūlavathomāntaṃ jitvādhiṣṭhanakaṃ nyaset(?)garbhaṃ nyasedārūḍhabhittikepuragrāmarājadhānyādiṣūditamtu vaprāntaṃ kuryānmadhye surālayeṣaṭtalāntāni madhyānāṃ gopurāṇyapi

sanskrit: stūpyantamuttarādūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍhā bhaktaṃ la gopuramkandharotsedhaḥ satripādāṃśakaṃ śiraḥdvitalādīnāṃ talādhikyavibhāgataḥgopuravyāsapañcāṃśe garbhāgāra tribhāgataḥgopuravyāse garbhaṃ tu caturaṃśakaiḥkūṭavistāraṃ tribhiraṃśaistu koṣṭhakamyathāśobhaṃ dvitalaṃ gopuraṃ bhavetśarabhaumaṃ syāt sūryāṃśe ṣaṭtale tathāmūladvārasya vistārād vedaśonaṃ śarāṃśataḥsopānamuparyupari vinyasetyathāśobhaṃ tathā yojyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥkuryādākṛtiśobhādyaṃ vimānabhavanādiṣuramyaṃ [g: mya] mahādvāraṃ pradakṣiṇamūhapratyūhaśobhāḍhyaṃ dvisaptamu(pa? kha)paṭṭikampārśve tyaktvā pūrvatalaṃ punaḥekadevasabhāśīirṣaṃ ṣaṇmahānāsikānvitamparito bhāgavṛddhyā sagaṇḍimambhaktyā yuktaṃ bhavyābhidhānakamkarṇeṣu pauṣṭikaṃ nāma gopuramkhaṇḍaharmyapatākāḍhyaṃ sumaṇḍākhyaṃ tu gopuramsastambhakūṭaśālaṃ satoraṇamdevaśreṣṭhanarendrārhaṃ subhadraṃ nāma gopuramcaturnāsīsāṅgāvayavasundaramaṣṭāśrakūṭaśālāḍhyaṃ bhadrasundarasaṃjñitamtu talaiḥ saptabhiranvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ceti ca talliṅgamacalaṃ ca calaṃ dvidhāmukhaliṅgaṃ syānmiśralakṣaṇalakṣitamkṣaṇikaṃ ceti ṣoḍhā syāt kramālliṅgaṃ tu niṣkalamkṛṣṇāśca liṅgāni kuryāt tābhiryathākramamdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dadyuḥ śuklādikāḥ śilāḥvidrumaṃ puṣyaṃ ratnaliṅgaṃ tathāṣṭadhābhedāḥ syuḥ kāmamokṣārthadāḥ kramātpadmarāgādiliṅgānāṃ kramaśo'rcanātkalaṅkaśca kākāṅghrikṣatadhūlayaḥrājataṃ tāmraṃ paittalaṃ kāṃsyamāyasambhuktimuktipradaṃ haimaṃ liṅgaṃ raupyaṃ tu puṣṭidamāyurārogyadaṃ vidyādāyasaṃ maraṇaṃ smṛtamcatvāri hemādīni śubhāni hidevadāruśca śamīpippalaśiṃśapāḥviprādīnāṃ tryastrayaḥtīrthakṣetrācalārāmapuṇyadeśodbhavāṃ mṛdamyavagodhūmamāṣāṇāṃ cūrṇānāṃ guggulorapipakṣaṃ māsamātroṣitaṃ punaḥśoṣayed dharme liṅgamāmaṃ tu mārttikampañcagavyādbhirmāsamātraṃ tathoṣitāmkuśalairagnau pakvaṃ liṅgaṃ tu tad bhavetca liṅgāni saptaiva kṣaṇikāni tukṣaṇaliṅgāni yajatāṃ prativāsaramtrikhaṇḍaṃ mānaṃ vā na śirovartanādikamsadyastalliṅge śivamāvāhya pūjayet

sanskrit: svayoniḥ piṇḍikaiva syācchailādīnāmadūṣaṇātāmrajā vā syācchreṣṭhamadhyādhamakramātuttarāyaṇasaṃsthe'rke śuklapakṣe guṇānvitedvijānagre vācayitvāśiṣastataḥprācīmudīcīṃ vā nimittānyupalakṣayanpuṣpānnapūrṇakumbhājyaśaṅkhakṣīradadhīni camaṅgalyayoṣito rājā dhvajapūrṇadhanūṃṣi cayāturiṣṭārthasiddhyai syāt sutarāṃ tat pradakṣiṇamśastaṃ kṣutaṃ hyādāvaśobhanambharaṭādīnāṃ vāme śastaṃ tu dakṣiṇesṛgālavāyasavyāghracakorabakapotakāḥśaśakauśikagṛdhrāśca śyenāśca mṛgaḍuṇḍubhāḥbāleyagodhvanirvāme gatirdakṣiṇataḥ śubhāvātyā kalahaśceti ninditāḥvarṇavāhanaveṣāṇāṃ manaśśastradiśāmapipratisūryoparāgolkābhūkampendradhanūṃṣi cacakrikṣapaṇanagnāśca muṇḍitāmaṅgalāṅganāsūnāḥ pāṣaṇḍā daṇḍapāṇayaḥārdravastrāśca nindyāḥ syurdṛṣṭāḥ pratimukhāgatāḥyaduddiṣṭaṃ girikṣetravanādikammahendrasahyamalayāḥ kalaśo vedaparvataḥgaṅgādikāḥ kṣetrāṇyamareśādikānyapisyuryathālābhaṃ śilāgrahaṇamārabhetśilā jñeyāstattannāmopalakṣitāḥyuktā bhūrvāruṇī smṛtā

sanskrit: yāmyāṃ ca sā māhendrī kṣitiḥ smṛtādūrapānīyā bhūrāgneyī vininditānirjalā bhūmiraśubhā vāyavī smṛtāmāhendryāṃ sambhūtāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥvalmīkāhiśmaśānāḍhyā nindyā bhūrapi tacchilāśilāyāśca grahaṇe ninditāstyajetanveṣayecchilāṃ tatra mantraṃ cedamudīrayetdeveśa ! prasanno vṛṣabhadhvaja !śuklagandhasragālepau bhūṣitau śilpibhirvṛtaubhūtāni devatāśca saguhyakāḥsādhayiṣyāmi kriyatāṃ vāsaparyayaḥtadambhobhirabhiṣicya śilāṃ punaḥcācchādya paścime'gnau juhoti capāśupatāstreṇa śataṃ hutvā punarghṛtamdarbheṣu svaped rātrāvimaṃ japanviśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥkāryāṇi hṛdayasthāni yāni vaivā śobhanaṃ grāhyā syācchilā liṅgakarmaṇisnātvābhipūjyeśamācāryaḥ sthapatistathāmukhaṃ tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhamūrdhvaṃ tu pūrvataḥśilā tyājyā bharturduḥkhakarī yataḥmukhamūlaśiraḥpṛṣṭhānyaṅkayitvāmbarāvṛtāmpelavā ca śilā bālā vininditāromarekhā caṇḍālī sā ca varjitāliṅgayogyā syād vṛttā vṛttāyatā ca sā

sanskrit: kāryaḥ prakāro'nyaśca kathyatenavabhāge syālliṅgaṃ pañcāṃśamāyatamtatraikahastaliṅgasya caturhastaṃ tu vistṛtamdviguṇoccaṃ tu nāgaraṃ triguṇaṃ yadivalabhirnāma vimānaṃ bhavati sphuṭampauṣṭikaṃ sārvakāmikaṃ nāgare smṛtamtrayodaśāṃśakaṃ mukhyaṃ garbhe'ṣṭāṃśe tu pūrvavatpauṣṭikaṃ sārvakāmikaṃ drāviḍe bhavettrayodaśāṃśamadhamaṃ tayormadhye'ṣṭabhāgataḥdairghye vasusaptaṣaḍaṃśakaiḥliṅgānāṃ brahmaviṣṇavīśadaivatamtribhāgamevaṃ vijñeyaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaśca likhyatecaturdhā syāt tallakṣma pṛthagucyateviśāmiṣṭaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ svastikaṃ hitamanyavarṇoditaṃ liṅgamihāmutrārthanāśanamliṅgavistāraḥ pariṇāhastu tasya yaḥbrahmaviṣṇvīśabhāgāḥ sarvasame matāḥvedāśrapiṇḍikāyāstu liṅge sarvasame tvidamsyācchāyādoṣo'nyathā bhavetvedāśrapiṇḍikākṣetrāpekṣayā vartulādiṣukṛśeṣu liṅgeṣu piṇḍikādhikavistṛtamśivāṃśe tu brahmāṃśe hāpayet tu tatpūjābhāgaṃ tu kuryāddhrasvaṃ tadaṃśataḥchāyādoṣavicāro'yaṃ liṅge sarvasame smṛtaḥvyaktāvyakte ca ratnaje

sanskrit: vardhamānādiliṅgānāṃ trayāṇāmapyayaṃ vidhiḥliṅgāyatipramāṇānītyādinā pīṭhavistṛtiḥsaṃkṛtyaṃśe tu liṅgocce saptāṣṭanavabhiḥ kramātprakṛtyaṃśe ṣaṭsaptāṣṭāṃśakalpitāḥpañcaṣaṭsaptabhāgairvā catuṣpañcaṣaḍaṃśakaiḥliṅgāyāme tu paṅktyaṃśe rāmāgniśrutisammitaiḥliṅgotsedhe tu nandāṃśe ṣaṭsaptavasubhāgikaiḥtrairāśikaṃ nāma bhavet sarvasame tu tatvardhamānaṃ ca talliṅgaṃ nāmnā suragaṇārcitamkāraṇākhye ca yathoktaṃ tatra kathyateviśāṃ yogyaṃ saptāṃśādyaṃ tu vārṣalamākṛtyaṃśe tu liṅgocce saptasaptāṣṭabhāgikamtrayodaśāṃśe liṅgocce vedavedaśarāṃśakaiḥṣaḍbhiśca bhāgairbrahmādyaiḥ kṣatrayogyaṃ śivādhikamdaśāṃśe tu guṇāgniśrutibhāgikampūrvoktasamaliṅge tu dhārāliṅgaṃ vikalpataḥca śaivāṃśe dhārādvidviguṇīkṛtesarvatobhadraliṅge tu dhārāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥtu dhārāyāṃ catvariṃśatprasaṃkhyayābrahmādibhāgasiddhau tu vedāśraṃ proktamārgataḥkoṇārdhasūtralāñchanamadhyataḥliṅgavistāraṃ saptadhā vibhajet samamsiddhyati samamatha vṛttaṃ nigadyatedigantamānena bhrāmayed vṛttasiddhayetrapuṣākāraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍanibhaṃ tathā

sanskrit: pūjāṃśāyāmatattvāṃśādekadvitryaṃśakāt kramātsaṃsthāpyopari netrordhvaṃ śirasaḥ siddhaye punaḥtanmadhye binduṃ sampādya śāstrataḥvartanaṃ kuryācchatrākārādisiddhayeke'dhaḥ saṃlambya liṅgasyobhayapārśvayoḥdvitīyaṃ ca samaliṅge niyojayetsaṅkaraṃ naiva kuryāt tadaśubhaṃ yataḥśiraḥ sidhyed rāmāṃśaiḥ kukkuṭāṇḍakamliṅgavyāse'ṣṭadhā bhakte sārdhāṃśatrayavartanātsarvaliṅgeṣu vartanāstrapuṣādikāḥsthūlaśiraskaṃ ca caturdheti mayoditamca hīnaṃ ca sthūlamūlādikaṃ smṛtamśivāṃśo vṛtta eva syācchiraso vā na vartanamcātidīrghāṇi phalakāsadṛśāni caṣaṭpañcatridaśāgrāṇi mānonmānādibhirvināsapīṭhānyapyapīṭhāni sālayānyagṛhāṇi vādarśanasparśanārcābhireṣāṃ siddhiranuttamāśodhayet teṣāṃ śodhanaṃ sarvanāśakṛtmūrtivibhāgo'sti na ca syānmantrasaṅkaraḥbāṇaliṅgaṃ tu yat sarvaṃ yathājātaṃ nidhāpayetpīṭhe salakṣaṇe śaile saudhe vā sthāpayecchubhegobālarajjubhiścaiva gharṣayennirvraṇaṃ samamśuddhāmbugokṣīranālikerekṣuvāribhiḥsarṣapamātraṃ ced yatra syuḥ svarṇabindavaḥtyājyaṃ liṅgaṃ pīṭhaṃ ca tad bhavet

sanskrit: tithinakṣatrakaraṇamuhūrtādau guṇānvitesavitānaṃ caturdvāraṃ pradīpādyairalaṅkṛtamsitavastrayugāstīrṇe tasmilliṅgaṃ tu śāyayettu talliṅgaṃ namaskṛtyābhipūjya camayā jñānāt tvayi yad duranuṣṭhitamdeveśaṃ liṅge lakṣaṇamuddharetbrahmasūtraṃ pārśvasūtre śivāstrataḥsamaṃ sūtrāṇyālambayet sphuṭamsavatsāṃ gāṃ dvijaṃ svarṇaṃ ca kanyakāmpādonabhāgamardhaṃ vā brahmasūtraviśālatāpārśvasūtrasya rekhā madhyayavā bhavetnandadigrudrabhāgoccaṃ hīnādyuccamihoditamyugāgnidvitaye madhye bāṇayunāgniṣudrāviḍe sūtravyāsaḥ svāṃśārdhataḥ samaḥṣoḍaśāṃśe śivāyāme sūtrāyāmo daśāṃśataḥmukulākāramārabhya pārśvasūtradvayaṃ kramātṣoḍaśāṃśe'dho bhāgaṃ vedāṃśamūrdhvataḥitthaṃ drāviḍaliṅgasya lakṣaṇoddhāraṇaṃ smṛtamdaśāṃśaḥ syād vasvaṃśaprabhṛti kramāttayoryutirbhavecchreṣṭhe viṣkambhaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśataḥtrayoṃ'śāścādhoṃśā guṇabhāgāt prabhṛtyadhaḥtridhā bhakte vyāso bhāgadvayena tukaniṣṭhavesarasyātha dvādaśāṃśe śivocchrayepūrvavajjñeyo vyāse vai ṣoḍaśāṃśakekaniṣṭhavesarasyaivaṃ lakṣaṇoddharaṇaṃ smṛtam

sanskrit: dhṛtyaṃśe vedāṃśānupari tyajetdvyaṃśaṃ tathā pṛṣṭhe bhāgābhyāṃ tu yutirbhavetnālaṃ daśāṃśaiḥ syādaṣṭāṃśaiḥ pārśvayoryutiḥavicchinnamatisnigdhamajarjharamanākulambhasmanā pūrvamāsphālya mukulaṃ tataḥchatrābhamastake liṅge sūtrāgraṃ syād gajākṣavattrapuṣābhe tu sūtrāgraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍavatliṅgānāṃ sūtrāgramatha kathyatesāmānyaṃ hi yavopamammadhyasūtratatidvyaṃśastadardhaṃ pakṣasūtrayoḥvṛddhāvaṅgulivicchedaṃ parihṛtyāṅguliṃ punaḥbhāni syuḥ śiṣṭānyatra yathākramambhojanaṃ śaktirdhanaṃ rājā napuṃsakamvipat ṣaṇḍho vipannindyāḥ pare śubhāḥdhanamṛṇaṃ caiva yoniśca syād yathākramamdhvajasiṃhavṛṣebhāścecchubhāścānye hyaśobhanāḥśubhadāḥ śubhāḥ krūrāstvaśobhanāḥrājñaśca deśasya taduktaṃ sampadāṃ padamtallakṣaṇoddhāravidhiśca gītaḥsaṃyogaṃ tu liṅgānāṃ pratiṣṭheti vidurbudhāḥdārave liṅge svajātiścenna labhyateṣaṇḍhena syāt pādaśilā strīśilā piṇḍikā bhavetpūjāṃśadviguṇaṃ hīnaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ liṅgonnateḥ samamtribhāgaikaṃ caturthāṃśamathāpi vākuryāt tu viṣṇvaṃśasamānoccaṃ hi sarvathā

sanskrit: pīṭhānāṃ janmāntaṃ mūlavistṛtiḥnāgarāditrayāṇāṃ tu pīṭhalakṣaṇamucyatedvyaṃśato nīcaṃ tayormadhye'ṣṭabhāgikeśreṣṭhaṃ dvibhāgoccaṃ nīcaṃ vyāsārdhamunnatamtrikhaṇḍena tulyavyāsamihottamamtayormadhye'ṣṭabhāge tu pīṭhavyāsā nava smṛtāḥśeṣāṃśoccaṃ tu nīcādi pīṭhocco drāviḍe mataḥtatsamaṃ vyāsaṃ jagatyaśaistathādhamamsarveṣāmapi liṅgānāṃ pīṭhoccādavaśeṣitampīṭhamūlasya vistārād vasunandadigaṃśakaiḥcaturaśrāṇi vasvaśravṛttānīti tribhedataḥvardhamānaṃ dvitīyaṃ syāllakṣmīsundaramapyathasamāṅgabhadrākhyaṃ rudrakāntaṃ tataḥ parampuṣṭivardhanasaṃjñaṃ ca sarvasaumyaṃ tataḥ paramniṣkalaliṅgānāṃ vijñeyaṃ sarvataḥ samampīṭhocce bhāgāt syānmūlapaṭṭikādvyaṃśaṃ punaḥ padmamardhamardhena kampakamardhena kampo dvyaṃśāt syāt krameṇaivordhapaṭṭikāpīṭhocce janmadvyaṃśamihoditamtribhistadvat kampamekena paṭṭikāmtu pīṭhocce janmasārdhāṃśato bhavetdhṛtyaṃśādekenābjaṃ tu kārayetkaṇṭhaṃ tathāṃśena vājanaṃ tvatha bhāgataḥlakṣmīsundarasaṃjñaṃ tu pīṭhamevaṃ prasidhyatijagatyabjavetrapaṅkajapaṭṭikā

sanskrit: aṣṭādaśāṃśe pīṭhocce bhavet sārdhāṃśataḥ khuramcārdhenopapaṭṭaṃ kaṇṭhastryaṃśastadūrdhvataḥvājanamuddiṣṭamardhaṃ paṭṭājyabhṛd bhavetpīṭhatuṅge tu ghṛtavāryardhataḥ smṛtāḥpañcāṃśā jagatī tadvat sārdhāṃśena khuraṃ bhavetatyaṣṭyaṃśe tu pīṭhocce khuraṃ bhāgena vaprakamkampo'rdhamardhenāmbhojaṃ vṛttaṃ dvāvardhato dalamdvyaṃśaṃ vājanamardhena padmaṃ kṣepaṇamardhataḥgalaṃ cārdhamabjaṃ vṛttamatyardhato bhavetvetraṃ sārdhāṃśaistribhirūrdhvāmbujaṃ bhavetpīṭhocce ṣoḍaśāṃśe tu bhāgābhyāṃ mūlapaṭṭikāvṛttaṃ tu bhāgenārdhena paṅkajamdhṛtabhṛt proktametat sarvāṅgabhadrakamnetrendubhirjagatyabjadhṛgvetraṃ dhṛk ca paṅkajamsārdhāṃśājjagatyardhena kampakamṣoḍaśāṃśe khuraṃ dvyaṃśamathārdhataḥvajramekaṃ syādūrdhvābjaṃ vedabhāgataḥsāmānyaṃ nāgarādīnāṃ saumyaṃ pīṭhamudīritamāyāmastatsamastasmāt tricaturbhāgahāapanātrāmāṃśāt khātaṃ vyāsasamonnatiḥsyādūrdhvapaṭṭabahulaṃ samaṃ pādādhikaṃ tu vāmūlaparyantaṃ tatkrameṇonnataṃ bhavetadhomaṇḍanamekaṃ vā syānnaikaṃ copapattitaḥuparyaṅgāvasānaṃ tadūrdhvasantānamācaretvedartuvasusūryāśraiḥ ṣoḍaśāśraṃ ca vartulam

sanskrit: pīṭhotsedhe tripañcāṃśe janmadvyaṃśaṃ yugāṃśakaiḥkṣepaṇamadhyardhaṃ kaṇṭho'rdhaṃ kṣepaṇaṃ punaḥpadmapīṭhampīṭhatuṅge tu manvaṃśe sārdhaṃ janmārdhato'vaṭamvajraṃ nimnamardhaṃ kampo'rdhaṃ tribhirambujamvajrapadmāhvayaṃ pīṭhaṃ sarvaliṅgasamaṃ bhavetcaturbhiḥ paṭṭamardhaṃ syādardhaṃ nimnaṃ tu sārdhataḥtribhirūrdhvāmbujaṃ paṭṭamardhamadhyardhamambujampīṭhotsedhe ṣoḍaśāṃśe candrāgniśrutisaṃkhyayādhṛk paṅkajaṃ tryaṃśaṃ paṭṭikā sārdhabhāgikātadvyāsanirgamau tryaṃśau tathāgraṃ śrīkaraṃ smṛtamnimnaṃ paṭṭanimne'bjapīṭheardhyardhendvardhasārdhāśvibhāgairadhyardhakārdhakaiḥkṣepaṇāmbhojapaṭṭāni nimnaṃ ceti yathākramamtu sūryāṃśe candranetrārdhabhāgataḥadhyardhena tathārdhena janmapadmakanimnakampaṭṭikānimnakaṃ paṭṭaṃ śrīkāmye tu kramād bhavetpīṭhānāmaṅgānāṃ parikalpayetsyānnirgamaḥ praṇālasya mūlavyāsaṃ ca tatsamamgajauṣṭhākāramathavā gomukhābhaṃ ca tad bhavetiṣṭadiṅmukhaliṅgānāṃ praṇālaṃ pīṭhamadhyataḥvistāraṃ soccatulyaṃ prakalpayetpaṭṭasya samaṃ khātaṃ tu mūlataḥtvardhacandrākhye pīṭhe syād dvārasammukhampīṭhāśraṃ vedhasaṃ na praśasyate

sanskrit: doṣāya syāt tat pariharet tataḥtadalābhe'pyekayaiba prakuryādūrdhvamaṇḍanammadhye karṇe sandhirna śasyatetrikhaṇḍaṃ naikakhaṇḍaṃ vā yuktyā kuryādadhogatampūjāṃśadviguṇā nīcā tayormadhye'ṣṭabhāgikesvavyāsārdhonnatā mukhyā nīcā vedāṃśato ghanāḥliṅgaviṣkambhācchreṣṭhā syād dviguṇā ghanātbrahmaśīlāmadhye brahmabhāgopamaṃ bhavetratnanyāsānvitaṃśliṣṭaṃ liṅgamūlena tad bhavetpīṭhabrahmātmanormadhye prādakṣiṇyena yojayetekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṇmātraṃ vādhikaṃ tataḥnijāyāmā maṇḍanaṃ piṇḍikāsvivaproktaḥ śayane vāsane sthitebrahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca (śau? gau)ryādīnāṃ tathāsanamdaivārṣakāṇāṃ bāṇānāṃ liṅgānāṃ ca svayambhuvāmdviguṇaṃ liṅgavistārād vistṛtaṃ vedabhāgataḥgarbhakarṇacaturthāṃśavyāsā śreṣṭhāyatasya tutu navadhā brahmaśilāḥ syurdrāviḍe śivebrahmaśilāyāḥ syānnavadhā drāviḍāhvayevyāsārdhavedabhāgoccā prāgvanmadhye'ṣṭabhājitedviyavādhikavistāraṃ vistārāṣṭāṃśataḥ smṛtamihālaṅkaraṇaistvāṣṭravidāṃ prītikaraḥaśvinetrāgnibhāgaiḥ syāt skandhaḥ kaṇṭhastathānanambhāgena mukhaviṣkambho vistṛtaścordhvaliṅgavatmānonmānapramāṇena sarvaṃ sakalavat smṛtam

sanskrit: lokapālāṣṭamūrtīśavidyeśavasubhogināmmarudgaṇānapsaraso'pyastramūrttīśca guhyakānsiddhānasuragandharvān kaniṣṭhanavatālataḥbhūtāni tritālād yakṣakinnarānpratimākaraṇaṃ tattaddehalabdhāṅgulena tucaturviṃśatyadhikaṃ śatabhāgikevidyādekāṃśaṃ yavamevaṃ paratra casavikāraśatāṃśeṃ'śaḥ kaniṣṭhadaśatālakevedāṃśaśatāṃśeṃ'śo navatāle tu madhyameṣaṇṇavatyaṃśakeṃ'śaḥ syācchreṣṭhe tu vasutālakesaptatālādiṣu kramātmātraṃ cāpyaṅgulaṃ ca samaṃ smṛtamakṣigolakapakṣastu dvyaṅgulasyābhidhāyakaḥatha śreṣṭhāt paṅktitālāt pratimāmānamucyatetato'kṣisūtraṃ vedāṃśaiḥ sayavatritayaistataḥvedayavaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhastu saptabhiḥtrayodaśāṅgulaistasmānnābhistāvadbhiraṅgulaiḥaṅgulairūrumānaṃ syāt tasmād bhāgena jānunītu pārṣṇyantaṃ talaṃ saptadaśāṅgulamkorparaṃ tasmāt trisaptāṃśaiḥ prakoṣṭhakamtiryagvistāraḥ karṇānto dvādaśāṅgulaḥekāśīterardhamātraiḥ sabāhvantaravistṛtiḥkakṣayorantaravyāso dvāviṃśatyaṅgulairmataḥhṛdayāvadhivistāraḥ sārdhāṣṭādaśamātrikaḥśroṇervyāsaḥ kaṭivyāso viṃśatyaṅgulasaṃmitaḥ

sanskrit: bhānvaṃśairūrumadhyasya jaṅghāmūle'ṣṭamātrakaiḥvistṛtāthākṣigulphāntaṃ sa yaveṣvaṃśavistṛtamṣaḍaṃśaḥ prapadavyāsastalāgrasya saṣaḍyavaḥtadardhena tadardhānnakhavistṛtiḥvedarāmāgnidṛṅmātraiḥ satriṣaṭkacaturyavaiḥkramājjñeyo navabhiḥ sārdhasaptakaiḥsapādāṣṭāṃśasaptāṃśairdormadhye korpare tatiḥsaptāṅgulāyāmaṃ madhyā sārdhaṣaḍaṅgulāsapādeṣvaṅgulānāmā kaniṣṭhābdhyaṃśapādayukaṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntamaṅgulīnāṃ tatirbhavetaṅgulyagratate'gnyaṃśe dvyaṃśavyāsā nakhāḥ pṛthaksvanakhāyāmādagraparva pṛthak pṛthakmadhyāyāḥ satripādākṣi sapañcayavamātrataḥyacchiṣṭaṃ madhyemūlāgraparvaṇoḥsārdharturasasārdheṣumātravyāsastalasya tutarjāmūlato'gnyaṃśaistathāṅguṣṭhasya mūlataḥsārdhayugmāṃśaṃ [śā] karaparṣṇyā ghanaṃ kalācakraśaṅkhābjamakarasvastikādyaṅgavat talamkarṇayormadhyanāhaḥ prāg dvāviṃśatyaṅgulaiḥ smṛtaḥmūrdhno madhyāṃt tu keśāntamānamuktaṃ navāṅgulambhrūyugaṃ kuryāt sajyacāpānataṃ śubhambhrūvorantaramardhāṃśāccharāṃśairāyataṃ bhrūvoḥkalāyāmavyāsā syādatha ṣaḍyavaḥṣaḍyavo netravistāro netrānto'rdhayavo'ruṇaḥūrdhvādhovarmavistāro yavaṃ cārdhayavaṃ bhavet

sanskrit: nāsāpuṭāntasīmāntavyāsapādāṃśapakṣataḥtu nāsāgraṃ dvyaṅguloccaṃ puṭordhvataḥnāsādvāroccavistārau pañcasaptayavairmataumadhyakuḍyocccatāṃśena tadvyāso'rdhayavaḥ smṛtaḥsārdhavedayavāyāmā gojī [k: jjī] tasyārdhatastatātadvyāsaḥ sārdhatriyava īritaḥtrivakrāvanatā tāvadāsyāyataṃ bhavettatpālī tvadhaḥ sārdhayavaṃ tataḥnimnaṃ hanustriyavamunnatākarṇabandhāddhanormadhyaṃ daśāṅgulamudīritamnetrāntāt saptāṃśaiḥ śravaṇāntaramkarṇabandhaḥ syāt sayavāṃśadvayāyataḥmātrārdhamātravistāre syātāṃ sārdhāṃśato ghanetadardhavistṛtā vātha piñcūṣī syāt kalāyatācaturyavāyatā karṇapālī sārdhayavād ghanākaṇṭhordhvakeśānte'rdhāṃśanimnā kṛkāṭikāsāṣṭārdhamātraṃ tadadhaḥ skandhasīmni daśāṅgulaiḥhikkāsūtrordhvataḥ skandhasandhirvedāṃśamunnataḥkaṇṭhādadhoṃśena kakut tasmādadhoṅgulaiḥkakuddeśādadho hitvā vedāṃśāt kakṣayoḥ sthitiḥrasāṅgulayavaiḥ kakṣādūrdhvaṃ bāhvoḥ samucchrayaḥtadadhastryaṅgulo vyāso vaṃśo dvyaṅgulanimnavānbṛhatyorāstanaṃ madhye ghanaṃ ṣoḍaśamātrakaiḥvikārāṃśairghanaṃ tasmādadhaścātyaṣṭimātrakaiḥardhonakṛtimātrā syāt kaṭibandhasya vistṛtiḥ

sanskrit: sārdhavedāṃśataścorumūlāt spikpiṇḍanirgatiḥgrīvātha tannāhe yugmarekhā samanvitāsārdhatrayodaśāṃśaiḥ syuḥ kakṣāt kakṣadharā tatiḥstanapīṭhonnatirdvyaṃśāt sayavaṃ kucavartulamsyājjānuyugmaṃ dvimātrakamsayavabāṇāṃśā śroṇī pārśve rasāṃśakāsayavadvayabāṇāṃśadīrghaṃ sayavavṛttataḥsyānmeḍhrādūrdhvorubandhanamsārdhakalayā pārśvabandhastu bhāgataḥtūccanimnādyamanyadūhyamataḥ paramdaśatālena beraṃ kurvīta sundaramberocitapummānamaśeṣādihauṣṇīṣāt tasmād bhāgaḥ saṣaḍyavaḥsyādatha hanvantaṃ rāmāṃśaistu saṣaḍyavaiḥtrayodaśāṃśaiḥ syurūrū ṣaḍviṃśadaṅgulaiḥpādau ca talau bhāgāyāmau prakalpayetkramādarghāṅgulānāḥ syuḥ śeṣāstvaṅgulayaḥ pṛthaksārdhasaptayavā madhyānāmā saptayavaistataḥudañcitāgrāḥ kiñcit te pārṣṇivyāsastu bhāgataḥrasāṅgulaistalāgraṃ syādakṣagulphau śarāṅgulaiḥsaptamātrairūrvorvyāsastu tālataḥcaturmātrairaghovyāsastaccāśvatthadalākṛtiṣaḍyavavyāsanimnā syānnābhirmadhye'ntatastanuḥstanādho'tijagatyaṃśairnandāṃśaiḥ syāt pratistanamstanākṣamardhamātraṃ syād dviyavaḥ syāt tadunnatiḥ

sanskrit: sabāhusīmāvistāraḥ syādekatriṃśadaṅgulaiḥdhṛtyaṃśaistu prakoṣṭhaṃ syāt talaṃ saptāṅgulāyatamnandarṣivasvṛṣirasayavairaṅgulayastatāḥnakhāyāmastalavyāso rasāṅgulaiḥmūlaṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ syāt krameṇa tubhaved vaktraṃ sārdhāṃśakalayā bhrūvoḥsayavāṃśāt puṭādāsyaṃ gojidairghyaṃ tadardhataḥtadāyāmastrivargottarapālikāyavavistīrṇā sayavadvayabhāgataḥcibukaṃ dviyavaṃ tatra kaṇṭhaveśastato hanoḥsadviyavābdhyaṃśairnālalambaḥ śarāṃśakaiḥkarikarākārau syād vapuḥ sarvasundarammadhyena daśatālena mānaṃ puṃso'tha kathyatekeśāntānnetrāntaṃ ca puṭāntakam(?) hṛdayāntaṃ syājjagatyaṃśaiḥ saṣaḍyavaiḥsaṣaḍyavābhikṛtyaṃśairūrvordairghyamudāhṛtamutkṛtyaṃśairbāhudairghyaṃ kalāyāmastu korparaḥtrayodaśāṅgulaiścātha sabāhvantaravistṛtiḥkaṇṭhabāhūnāṃ jānumadhyadvayaṃ tvadhaḥkakṣādharastu kalayā prakṛtyaṃśairurastatiḥtrayodaśaiḥ kukṣimadhyaṃ sārdhapañcadaśāṅgulaiḥkaṭivyāsastathaivorvormūleṃ'śaistu trayodaśaiḥśrutyaṃśairnalakāvyāsaḥ sapādaistu śarāṅgulaiḥsayavadvayavedāṃśaiḥ sapādeṣvaṅgulaistataḥsapādavedāṃśo'ṅguṣṭhastarjanyasmād yavādhikā

sanskrit: sārdhadvyaṃśā kaniṣṭhā ca vistāre'pi yathākramamnakhavyāsā vasviṣuśrutisaṃmitaiḥvasvṛṣisārdheṣusārdharāmāṅgulaiḥ kramāttalāyāmaḥ saptāṃśaiḥ syāt ṣaḍaṅgulaiḥla]ṣṭhayādairghyaṃ sapādaiścaturaṅgulaiḥaṅguṣṭhādyaṅgulīnāṃ tu syāt sūryavasunandakaiḥrāmāṃśe dvyaṃśā syānnakhavistṛtiḥśarāṃśaḥ syāt tadvyāso dvyaṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥkarṇāntarāyāmo bhavenmātraistrayodaśaiḥnetravistārastāvat syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaḥjyotiḥ syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamadhyagamapāṅge'rdhayave rakte dviyavenordhvavarma yatkāryaṃ tāvān karṇocchrayo bhavettadantaraṃ syādardhāṃśāt tayorānatiraṅgulāttāvān syāt sādhikāṃśaḥ sabhūṣaṇaḥtvardhamātrāt karṇamūlamapāṅgataḥkāryā ṣaḍyavaḥ puṣkarocchrayaḥpuṭāvardhāṅgulasamau syātāṃ yavaghanau ca tauuttaroṣṭhatatistvardhamātrāt pālitatiryavāttaddairghyaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasmāt tatpālī yavasaṃmitāsādhyardhayavamātraḥ syāt tataḥ sārdhadvimātrataḥkaniṣṭhadaśatālena strīmānamatha kathyatetataḥ puṭāntaṃ ca sayavairvedamātrakaiḥkaṇṭhāddhṛcca hṛdo nābhiḥ sārdhasūryāṅgulāntaramuṣṇīṣakakṣajānvaṅghritaloccaṃ vedamātrakaiḥ

sanskrit: sapādavedamātraiḥ syāt tataḥ sayavabhāgataḥnābhistato yoniḥ sārdhasūryāṅgulaiḥ pṛthakpadāyāmo bāhū corvoḥ samau matausārdhartvaṃśaistalāyāmaḥ ṣaḍaṃśairmadhyamāyatānandarṣyaṣṭarṣiṣaḍyavaiḥato yavādhikaṃ dairghyaṃ talavyāso rasāṃśataḥmadhyakorparabāhvośca trivadeṣurasastatamjānvośca vyāsaḥ saptāṃśatastatiḥtayostadardhamutsedhaścūcuke tu trimātrakastanādho'tijagatyaṃśairmadhye rudrāṅgulaistatiḥūrvorvyāsastu sūryāṃśairjaṅghāmadhye ṣaḍaṃśakaiḥpārṣṇivyāsonnatirbhāgāt talamadhyāgrayorapitarjanī madhyā sārdharāmāṅgulāyatārasarṣisārdharṣivasuvikārayavavistṛtāḥtatpādonāyatā vṛttā unnatāgrā manāk ca tepuṭādadho'ṅgulādāsyaṃ gojyāyāmastadardhataḥsyādadharastadardhena tu vistṛtaḥnetradairghyaṃ vyāsastu ṣaḍyavaiḥgojīmūlāt tu nāsoccaṃ syāt saṣaḍyavamātrataḥsyāccheṣamūhyaṃ hi pūrvavattu kaniṣṭhāt strīmānasyeha lakṣaṇaṃ kathitamtatromāskandayuktasya śambhorlakṣaṇamucyateśāyayet pīṭhe dakṣiṇaṃ tu pralambayetjānunorbāhyapārśve ca jānvantād bāhupārśvakamkuryāt sarvametad yathākramam

sanskrit: dakṣiṇaṃ jānu sūtrād dvitryaṅgulaṃ bhavetmanvaṃśairantaraṃ sūtrād dakṣiṇāt pāṇimadhyataḥasavyapāṇimadhyāgraṃ stanasūtrasamonnatamhikkāsūtrasame smṛtemeḍhrādakṣāntaraṃ tadvat kukṣispṛg ghrāṇasūtrakamkartarīhastāvantarvā bahirānanaudakṣiṇe haste vāme tu kaṭakaṃ karekeśāntāt satripādadvitālakamsahāsīnāṃ kuryād devasya pārvatīmdevāśritā namravadanā samalaṅkṛtāpīṭhasthavāmahastāthavā bhavetpañcatālena vibhajyāṅgāni kārayetsārdhatrimātraistaireva puṭāntaṃ ca tato hanuḥhikkāyā hṛt tato nābhirnābhermeḍhraṃ ca saṃmitamrudrāṃśaiḥ kalayā pādastalāyāmo daśāṅgulaḥsyāt talāyāmo madhyā ca caturaṅgulākaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhike tryaṃśe sotpalaṃ syāt karadvayamcandraśekharalakṣmātha samapādasthito bhavethikkāhṛdayaguhyoraḥ pādamadhyeṣu lambayetnābhisīmāntaṃ kaṭyantaṃ vāpi kārayetparahastāntaṃ daśāṅgulamathāpi vāekāṅgulenorumūle jānumadhyaṃ tu bhāgataḥaurdhvakartarihastau tu kuṭhāramṛgadhāriṇaupravālābhaḥ kāryaḥ syāccandraśekharaḥṛjuḥ sthito dakṣiṇāṅghrirvāmapādo'sya kuñcitaḥ

sanskrit: vāmabhāle tu vāmanetre puṭāntaketiraścīnajaṅgho'yamatibhaṅge tu nānyathāpātayennābherūrdhvaṃ prāgvadihāpi cakorparo vāmo hikkāto'ṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥkaṭīdeśāvalambī vā vāmetarakaro bhavetdevī lambavāmakarā bhavetnaṭeśvaraścaturbāhustriṇetraścandraśekharaḥsūryāṅgulaṃ vā sūtrasya lambanaṃ tvatha kathyatebhyo)stathā madhye savyagulphe ca pātayetparakarāgraṃ tadaṣṭapañcāśadaṅgulaiḥcatvāriṃśadbhiraṣṭāṃśaiḥ karṇasīmāsamo(bha? da)yamprasāritajaṭābhāraḥ kiñcit prahasitānanaḥgaṇairdevarṣiyakṣādyairvighneśaskandamātṛbhiḥnādayan nandī sūpavisṭaścaturbhujaḥsthitadakṣiṇapādaḥ syāt kuñcitānyapadāmbujaḥnābhideśād dakṣiṇe dvyaṅgule tataḥsācīkṛtaśarīraḥ syād vāmāṃśāvanatātataḥ(?)vāmordhvakareṇa hariṇaṃ dadhatcārayaiśca munibhirvandito bhavettripurāntakadavaḥ syād vaiśākhasthānakānvitaḥrāmavedeṣumātraiḥ syānnatimānaṃ triṣu kramātsapinākaḥ karo vāmaḥ kakṣāntoccaḥ karo'paraḥdevī vāmapārśve sthitā bhavetpuṭānte ca hikkāmadhye ca dakṣiṇedevasya gantukāmasya pāvakam

sanskrit: syāt parahastau yathāpuramśrībhūmibhyāmanugatā gaurī devānugāminīsarvadevarṣigandharvayakṣādyairvandito bhavetdvibhujo dakṣiṇāṅghriḥ sthito'sya tutu yat sarvaṃ prāgvadūhena kalpayetraudra ūrdhvakeśo bṛhattanuḥkaṅkālā gamanodyuktaścākrāntamaṇipādukaḥmṛgapotānanaṃ spṛśantu śirasā vahadbhūtapurogataḥtacchatracāmarakaragaṇāścaivānuyāyinaḥvāmakaraḥ sābhayo dakṣiṇo bhavetkirīṭārdhaṃ kapardārdhaṃ ca dakṣiṇeramyā tathā kāryāhyekā mūrtirharīśayoḥviprakīrṇajaṭābhāro digvāsā gamanodyataḥvāmastathāsyordhvakaradvayebhujaṅgahāropavītakaṭisūtravibhūṣitaḥumāsahitavat kuryāccaṇḍānugrahakaṃ paramkṛtāñjalipuṭaścaṇḍa āsīno'dhaḥ śivāsanaḥardharjubadanaścārujaṭājūṭavibhūṣitaḥsākṣamālānalakarastvadho dakṣiṇavāmayoḥdakṣiṇorusthavāmāṅghrirlambitānyapadāmbujaḥvidhātavyo vyākhyānavyāpṛto vibhuḥdakṣiṇabhujo bhavedākarṇamudbhṛtaḥbhya)ntaścāparastatra hala pallavasaṃyutaḥnābhyantoddhṛtajānuḥ syād vāmo'ṅghriḥ kālahṛdgataḥ

sanskrit: kāryo nāgābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥvivṛttākṣo vyāditāsyo bhayaṅkaraḥliṅgodbhavo liṅgamadhye candraśekharavat sthitaḥkāryo haṃsarūpī pitāmahaḥdvāraliṅgocchritaḥ śreṣṭho madhyo vedāṃśahānitaḥdvārādadhyardhamucco vā sapādadviguṇo'thavāpañcāśadaṃśe bhāgo'ṅgulaṃ smṛtampaṅktyaṃśairdīrghaḥ kaṇṭho'ṣṭamātrakaiḥdvimātraṃ jānu ṣaṇmātrā jaṅghā dvyaṃśonnataṃ khurambhālaṃ nandāṃśavistīrṇaṃ mukhavyāsaḥ śarāṅgulaiḥsārdhamātro'smād bhāgoccaṃ caturaṅgulamsārdhamātrāyataṃ ghrāṇaṃ tadvyāsāvaṭamaṅgulātdīrghātatoccātha kakut ṣaḍvedāṃśatanornatā (?)śarāṃśaiḥ syād dvyaṃśaṃ jānvatha jaṅghayoḥpucchāyāmastu jaṅghāntastryaṃśaistanmūlavistṛtītaḥtadāyāmo dvimātraḥ syācchephāyāmastrimātrakaḥatha triśūlaṃ dvāroccaṃ stambhoccaṃ vā vidhīyatevedarāmāśvisaṃkhyaiḥ śreṣṭhādikaṃ trayammadhyapatraṃ triparvakuliśākṛtimadhyapatremadhyaparva dviyavenādhikaṃ bhavetuttānāmbujavannālaṃ nālordhvaṃ pārśvapatrakepadmāgrāvadhi śūlāgrāt pārśvapatre tu vartayetpārśvapatrāntaḥ sīmāntaṃ vartayet samampādonamagraṃ syāt tripādād vārdhato ghanamveṇupatrākṛtī pārśvapatrāgre madhyapatrakaḥ (?)

sanskrit: pañcapañcāṃśāt syādaṅgād daṇḍavistṛtiḥmaṇḍikumbhādipādālaṅkāravad bhavetūhapratyūhato yuktyā śobhāṃ sarvatra yojayettatra vṛttaṃ samākhyātaṃ tritaye'pi ca tat samamsyādantare bhugnamardhataḥ parimaṇḍalātnālamūle tu tatprotaḥ syāccharāṃśataḥvetālaśūlavat sarvaṃ khaṭvāṅgasyāpi kārayetmayūrapiñchavṛttāḍhyaṃ phalakā mūlato bhavetkhaṭveṣāvat tu vedāśro daṇḍo'sya phalakākṛtiḥgaṇeśaḥ pañcatālastu svāsīno vā sthitau bhavetbhugnastu gūḍhaḥ syād gajavaktrastrilocanaḥsārdhatālāyatau pādau pīvaraḥ sarvato bhavetpravikīrya pūrṇakalaśaṃ dīpaṃ ca madhye nyasetjapādiṣu syātvājinamityubhābhyāmśannodevīrabhīti caṛg durgā prathamā bhavetpārayānavyo asmānādyaṃ tṛtīyakampṛtanājitamityādiḥ pañcamo mantra ucyatevyāhṛtibhistadvadaghorāstreṇa vai punaḥtathāmbuśeṣamdarbhaistu yathāvadiṣṭvāvastreṇa samāstṛtaṃ syātsahemavastrākṣatagandhapuṣpamvāstoṣpate dhruvā sthūṇāt tato gṛhyaṃbhayādinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prataraṇo na edhītyādināpi caśaṃnavargairjuhoti capañcagavyena dūrvāścāṣṭottaraṃ śatamsviṣṭakṛtaṃ paścādupalipya ca bhūtalamvāstoṣpata ityādinā kṣipetprakṣālya kasmiṃściccheṣājyaṃ śeṣamambu cavātha darbhamuṣṭyāthavā punaḥparyeti tataḥ sampūjya vai dvijānvācayitvāgre śivaṃ vāstviti vācayetpratiṣṭhā sthāpanaṃ tadvat sthitasthāpanamityapibrahmaśilāyāṃ talliṅgamādau nidhāya tubāṇaliṅgānāmārṣāṇāṃ ca svayambhuvāmsthitasthāpanamuddiṣṭaṃ jīrṇe cotthāpanaṃ bhavetathottarāyaṇe pūrvapakṣe lagne guṇānvitepūrvoktairhīne yukte susammatekuryāccaturaśraṃ tu maṇḍapamhastādinavahastāntaliṅgānāṃ prathamatrikeghṛtikṛtikaraiścotkṛtisammitaiḥekāśītipadāṃśasya syānmadhya[kh: tta]navakena tukuṇḍāṣṭakaṃ tu pūrvādidikṣu kuryād yathākramampadmākāraṃ ca vasvaśraṃ navamaṃ caturaśrakamrakṣovaruṇayormadhye liṅge syāt paścimāmukhekaniṣṭhāditriliṅgānāṃ ratnyaratnikarāṇi tupañcamūrtipakṣe tu pañca kuṇḍāni tānyapibhavet kuṇḍamaśaktau vā kaniṣṭhake

sanskrit: kuryādardhapramāṇena tadvat srapanamaṇḍapamṣaḍaṃśoccāṃ paritastu rasāṃśakaiḥca bhaveduttarataḥ śubhamnidrākumbhaṃ śāntikumbhāñchivakumbhāstravardhanīḥabhyaṅgapātraṃ vastrāṇi tadvaccaivāṣṭamaṅgalamca svarṇaṃ prabhūte madhusarpiṣīvṛṣebhaśṛṅgavalmīkasarastīrabhuvo mṛdaḥkṣīrāgajambvāmratvacaḥ kisalayāni casarvauṣadhīrdhātubījalohāni musalādikam[kh: kādhikārān] gulakhaṇḍaṃ ca guggulumtailaṃ khaṭvāṃ vā phalakāṃ navāmlakṣaṇoddhāramaṇḍapeśivakoṣṭhaṃ syāt prāgādyaṣṭadiśāsvapisyustattvāntaṃ koṣṭhakāni tuhomopakaraṇaṃ vāso dhūpopayogi yattvakkaṣāyādyamanile caiśe syāccandanādikamplakṣodumbarāśvatthanyagrodhaistoraṇāni tukaniṣṭhāditriliṅgānāṃ śarartumunikiṣkubhiḥnandarudrātijagatītuṅgaśūlānyanukramātśūlānāmaryamā mitrastvaṣṭā bhagapurandarauca devatāḥ proktāḥ prāgādyeṣu tryastrayaḥvibhūṣyordhvamadhivāsanamaṇḍapammuktādāmasragālambapūgapuṣpādyalaṅkṛtamdarbhasandarbhamārjanyā sapalāśapalāśayācopalipyāntargālitodakagomayaiḥ

sanskrit: darbhairakṣataiḥ kusumaiḥ sitaiḥtato'dhivāsanaṃ kuryādācāryo mūrtipairyutaḥnātyantabālavṛddhāṃśca śrutavṛttādibhūṣitānpañcapakṣe tān mantraistaireva pañcabhiḥvāhni pūrvaṃ kṛtvāṅkurārpaṇamsrātvā vāgyato maṇḍapāntikemaṇḍapād bāhye gaṇeśaṃ samyagarcayetprārthayet karma labdhānujñastato guruḥtveti vā svāṅgaiḥ śūlairāyojayedapiuttiṣṭhabrahmaṇomantrāt [k: n] prāgādyantāṃstu vinyasettathā madhye lokapālāyudhāṅkitānpītapadmāruṇān pāṇḍutāpiñchadhavalaprabhānadhyardhatoraṇāduccā dhvajāḥ sarve patākinaḥmahākālaḥ kumbhodaramahodaraumūrttidharairviprairvedikāyāstu madhyataḥkulaśīlaśrutācārasaṃpannāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥkṛcchrādivratasaṃśuddhā vṛtāḥ prāgeva pūjitāḥkuryuradhyayanasyādau svaśākhānumataṃ diśipuṇyāhasalilairmaṇḍapāntaḥ pradakṣiṇamtadaivādhyayanaṃ viprāḥ prārabheran yathādiśamyajet pūrvaṃ tārasvākhyānamontakamtatastoraṇaśākhānāṃ mūlakumbheṣu pūjayetcāgnijihvaṃ virūpākṣamathottaresahasravīcīṃ vimalāṃ śatadhārāṃ pramodinīmbhadrakarṇaṃ śvetakarṇaṃ ca nāmabhiḥ

sanskrit: tatastālatrayacchoṭipārṣṇighātanirīkṣitaiḥpaścimadvāramāsādya nārācāstraṃ prayojayetdehalyāṃ parikramya pradakṣiṇamvāstudaivādhipaṃ madhye brahmāṇaṃ svāsanaṃ tathākṛtvādau sakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥmūlābimantritoṣṇīṣamuttarīyaṃ ca dhārayancandanālipte śivahastaṃ vidhāya tutamātmamūrdhni vinyasya śivo'hamiti bhāvayanjñānakhaḍgakaraḥ prāgvat pañcakoṣṭhe yathāvidhivikirānaiśe śivakumbhāstravardhanīgandhapuṣpādyairvṛṣakesarivāhanesañjīvanāmṛtārtheśakusmān dvāreṣu yugmaśaḥmahākālaṃ bhṛṅgīśaṃ ca gajānanamsvadigvinyastakumbheṣu śakrādīn daśa dikpatīnparibhrāmya tu vinyasya kumbhaṃ darbhopasaṃhṛtaiḥśakrādilokeśāñ śivājñāṃ śrāvayet kramātsthātavyaṃ sāvadhānena tvāyāgāntaṃ śivājñayānivedyāntaṃ tatastasmai jñānakhaḍgaṃ samarpayetsahāmbena yāgādhyakṣeṇa śaṅkaraḥ !arghyaṃ nidhāya kumbhāgre vikirairyāgamaṇḍapātmadhyamakuṇḍāgra upaviśya yathāvidhipañcasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtyārādhya taṃ guruḥtattaddiganalāṃśāṃstu tattatkuṇḍe nidhāpayettarpaṇaṃ kuryāt tacca mūlaṃ śivāntikambrahmāṅgamantrāṇāṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ juhoti ca

sanskrit: saṃpātābhihutān kṛtvā gururmūrtidharaiḥ sahataccottare'thavaiśānyāmadhivāsanamaṇḍapātdakṣiṇavedyāṃ tu liṅgaṃ pīṭhe nidhāya tupuroktābhiḥ kaṣāyaiśca kramoditaiḥdvitīyāyāṃ vedyāṃ vā sthaṇḍile kṛtevidhānena lakṣaṇoddhāramācaretspṛśeyustalliṅgaṃ kuryurnīrājanaṃ tathāsvamantreṇāthavākuryāt pūjāṃ sādhāraṇena vāpañcagavyakuśāmbubhyāṃ gandhādbhiścābhiṣecayetrathādāvāropya bherīpaṭahaḍiṇḍimaiḥveṇumaḍḍukavīṇādivāditradhvanimaṅgalaiḥprekṣaṇīyairdhvajaiścānyairgrāmādestu pradakṣiṇamsvālipte devaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayettanmadhye pīṭhādau śāyayecchivamtatpārśve vinyaset pīṭhaṃ darbhavastrādibhūṣitamsaṃpūjya parito rakṣiṇastathāatītyottārayelliṅgaṃ tīre vinyasya pūjayetgandhapaṅktena raktakauśeyavāsasārathādiyānamāropya nṛttagītādimaṅgalaiḥkārayet tatra hiraṇyavasanādikampuṣpavṛṣṭīśca puṣkalāḥsāmānyārghyajalairmārgaṃ siñceyurmūrtidhārakāḥmaṇḍapadvāri devaṃ samavatārayetbhadrapīṭhasya vivare sthāpayecchivamkṣālitāṅghriḥ samācamya praviśya snānamaṇḍapam

sanskrit: vikirakṣepaṃ śivakumbhaṃ ca vardhanīmprācyāmekonapañcāśat kalaśān vinyaset kramātpadaṣaṭkaṃ pṛthag dikṣu koṇe koṇe catuṣpadamgomūtraṃ pañcagavyaṃ tathā payaḥsapta garbhābdhimaṣṭamaṃ kalaśaṃ smarettvājyaṃ gomayaṃ madhu caikṣavamjambīraṃ panasaṃ bilvameva catṛtīyāvaraṇasthāṃstu ghaṭān saṅkṛtisaṃkhyakānśatadruṃ yamunāṃ narmadāṃ ca sarasvatīmgodāvarīṃ kṛṣṇaveṇīṃ nandāṃ bhīmarathīmapinaimiśaṃ cātha gokarṇaṃ ca tripuṣkarambrahmabhiścāṅgairvinyasya navakaṃ yajettṛtīyāvaraṇe tattvaiḥ śaktyādyaistu dharontakaiḥkumbhān sakūrcān sūtraveṣṭitānsapidhānaphalākṣatānpaścimabhāge tu kṛtvā nava padāni tusaṃyuktamāpūryābhyarcya deśikaḥpañcabrahmabhirāpūrya hemakūrcānvitān yajetsāṅgaṃ samāvāhya samidājyatilāṃścarūndaśāṃśena hutvā saṃpātitaṃ ghṛtamhṛdā mūrdhni puṣpādyamapanīya tujaladhūpāntaraṃ puṣpairaśūnyaṃ mastakaṃ yathātatastvekonapañcāśatkalaśaiḥ sthāpanakramātgāyatryā cāpyāyasveti dugdhataḥtadvat tejo'sīti ghṛtena tu

sanskrit: ākṛṣṇeneti ratnakātjaladhūpāntaraṃ ceṣṭvā tṛtīyāvaraṇe ghaṭaiḥgandhādyairupahārāntamiṣṭvā tūryādinisvanaiḥmūlena deveśamabhiṣecayetpāvamānībhirmadhyena brahmabhiḥ punaḥkumbhasthaśivena śivayāpi capiṇḍikāṃ siktvā tataḥ śivaghaṭena tugandhena liṅgaṃ pāṭhaṃ ca lepayetpuruṣeṇa tu dāpayettrikhaṇḍeṣu tattat saṃsmṛtya saṃspṛśetpiṣṭadīpādyaiḥ puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥdvijairliṅgamutthāpyātodyamaṅgalaiḥ[kh: dvāraditya] datyādyādavatāryā (rgha? rca) yecchiamdantakhaṭvāṃ vā phalakāṃ vā dṛḍhāṃ navāmviracayed ramyāṃ sopadhānottaracchadāmcāmare matsyayugmaṃ ca nyased dikṣvaṣṭamaṅgalamśāyayecchirasā talpe śikhayāsyopadhānakamgṛhopakaraṇaṃ sarvamānīya vinidhāya tumṛtyuñjayena sahṛdā cāpohiṣṭheti cārcayetśivakumbhāstravardhanyau tatraivāpūrya pūjayetātmāditattvavijñaptyai sragbhiḥ sīmāḥ prakalpayetśarāve dve sthāpayenmaṅgalāṅkuraiḥprākāratritayaṃ kṛtvā teṣu lokādhipān nyasetkadrudraṃ bhāruṇḍaṃ camakāṃstathāupaviśyāsane paścālliṅge bhāgatrayaṃ smaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattveśvarairmūrtibhiśca nyasyenmūrttiśvarān sahahṛdbījamātmatattvaṃ namontakamtatastāraṃ śironvitamśirasā vidyātattveśvarāya caśivatattvaṃ tu praṇavena śikhādikamca | rudrāya nama ityantaṃ rudrabhāge tu vinyasetvinyasedaṣṭau triṣvaṅgeṣu pṛthak pṛthakca mahādevaṃ bhīmaṃ cetyaṣṭamūrtipānvinyasedaṣṭapakṣe tu svākhyāmantrairnamontakampratiṣṭhāyāṃ pañcapakṣe tu mūrtayaḥviṣṇustathā rudra īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥkalāḥ pañca mūrtayo mūrtipā apiliṅgottarasthāyāṃ snapitāyāṃ tu liṅgavatbrahmaśilāyāṃ ca sthitāyāṃ liṅgamūlataḥtatrāpyātmāditattveśīṃ kriyājñānecchayā sahadīptimatyugrā jyotsnākhyā cetanā tathāsādhakasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ bhogecchoḥ śuddha(ma? va)rtmanimūrtīśvaryastu tasyaiva pīṭhe'nantādayaḥ kramātjyeṣṭhā kriyājñāne ceccheti ṣaṭhitāstvimāḥkāścid devatāstāsāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu mūrtipāḥsyuḥdevatāstatpratiṣṭhāyāṃ kapālīśādimūrtipāḥnidhīśaśca vidyādhipatiraṣṭamaḥpratiṣṭhāyāmindrādyā mūrtipāḥ smṛtāḥsyurmūrtipāstvaṣṭāvasitāṅgādibhairavāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhārākhyo'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥpañcapakṣe tu tamā mohā ca ghorayāpratiṣṭhāsu samāno'yaṃ vidhirmataḥpratiṣṭhāsu kiryāśaktiṃ tu pīṭhagāmevaṃ vinyasya tattvāni tadīśān mūrttimūrttipāntattvādīnāmavasthānaṃ liṅgādau tatra bhāvayetkuṇḍeṣu ghṛtena juhuyuḥ pṛthaktrirāhutīrhutvā ātmatattvaṃ tu vinyasetpṛthvyādimūrttimūrttyadhipānapitato'rdhaṃ vā tattvādīnāṃ juhoti caathācāryādayaḥ sarve gatvā liṅgāntikaṃ sahajapeyurmūrttimūrttīśamantrānāhutisaṃkhyayāātmatattvādhipa ! brahman ! yāvalliṅgamidaṃ bhuvispṛśanto mūlamantreṇa kuśamūlena mūrtiṣuiti tattve vibhāvya tutārahṛtpūrvakaṃ prāgvad vidyātattvaṃ namontakamtathājyena mūrttimūrttīśvarāṃstathāliṅgasya japeyurmadhyamaspṛśaḥvidyātattveśa ! bho viṣṇo ! yāvalliṅgamidaṃ bhuviśāntikumbhāmbhasā prāgvat prokṣayeyuśca mūlataḥvidyāśivākhye tattve tu sandhāya ca namontakammūrttimūrttīśān pūrvavajjuhuyuḥ pṛthakspṛśanto'tha japeyurhutasaṃkhyayāśivatattveśa ! bho rudra ! yāvalliṅgamidaṃ bhuvievaṃ pīṭhe śivāyāṃ ca tattvādyaṃ svasvamūrttibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00233 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padāni vighnagāyatryāḥ padādhvānye tu pūrvavatmantrapādoditā ye tu mantrā vighneśvarasya tupratiṣṭhāpyāstanmantrāvaraṇādibhiḥtriguṇārkādibimbeśabrahmaviṣṇvīśapaṅkajemūrtipaiścāpi tṛtīyaṃ tu caturthakambhavedante vighnapāriṣadāya tugaṇādhīśaṃ sthirādyairatha saptabhiḥaṅgairgaṇeśagāyatryā gaṇānāṃtvādinā tataḥsarvatra hutvā nītvā dinatrayamkṛtvā tu karma cāpariṣecanātkumbhalokeśadvārapāṃstoraṇadhvajānvikīrya rātrau tu yathāvibhavamarcanamnityotsave gaṇeśasya dvāḥsthāḥ kuṇḍodarādayaḥpaścime vāyau tāro nāge tu caṇḍikāgaṇacaṇḍaśca tatraitān saṃpūjya vikired balimcordhve dvāraśrīrmadhyagoparimadhyahārāyāmaṣṭadikṣu gaṇeśvarāḥvirūpākṣo vikaṭo bahubhakṣyabhukprāgādi gajavaktraśca vighneśagaṇanāyakaunāgadanto rudravaktro(d)bhavastataḥnityotsavavidhistulyastulyaścaiṣa mahotsaveyathāpūrvaṃ gaṇān sarvānāvāhya vikired balimca bāhye daśadiśāsvapisārvabhaumaṃ supratīkaṃ ca dikkramātgaṇā ye tu vajrahastā mahābalāḥ

sanskrit: rātrau bhūtakrūreṇa vai balimsnapane śaivakathitāḥ svāṅgamūlataḥgaṇādhīśamupacārairyathoditaiḥye tatra likhyante tantra[kh: tra]coditāḥprāgvaccitrādibhedena śailī lohamayī tathāvā syāt ṣaṇmukhī ṣaṇmukhasya tudvibhujān dvinetrāneva kārayetvā caturhasto mayūrasthaḥ sthito'thavādhārayaṃstadvat kaṭisparśivarapradamadhohastāt prabhṛtyūrdhvaṃ syād dvādaśabhujo vibhuḥbibhrat kartavyaḥ ṣaṇmukho vibhuḥbibhrat ṣaḍvaktrastvekāsyo vā caturbhujaḥvā syād daṇḍaśaktidharo'thavāmaulikuṇḍalahārādyairyuktāḥ syuḥ skandamūrtayaḥpratiṣṭhāpyāḥ ṣaḍ vā dvādaśa mūrtayaḥtoraṇāni syurlokesāstrāṅkitā dhvajāḥpūrṇasenastataḥ parampratidvāraṃ lājakumbhau bījāṅkuraghaṭāvapidūrvākuśāgramāṣāśca vrīhayastaṇḍulāstilāḥskandaṃ mayūrasthaṃ kukkuṭe'straṃ ca vardhanīmtvākaraṃ netramokṣaṃ toyādhivāsanamkumārakumbhāstre mūrtikumbhāṃśca ṣaṇ nyasetātmāditattvabhāgeṣu brahmādīṃstriguṇānvitānsanatkumāraḥ skandaśca viśākhaḥ ṣaṇmukhastathādevayānī ṣaṣṭhī vidyā ca kukkuṭā
